# 1625 Independent People
## Rents Support Administrator
**We are excited to be recruiting for a Rents Support Administrator to join our Rents team.**
**This is an important role that provides day-to-day administrative support which supports the organisation in maximising its rental income which directly enables us to continue delivering high-quality support to all the young people we support.**
**​**
**If you have strong administrative and IT skills, combined with empathy and an understanding that the people we support may be facing challenges as they work towards independent living, we would love to hear from you.**
**​**
**​****Please find full details of how to apply via our website in the advert below. The deadline for application****submissions is 23:59, 18 August 2026.**
We aim to build a more diverse workforce that reflects the young people we support, including those from migrant, refugee and asylum-seeking communities. We therefore warmly encourage applications from individuals who are currently under-represented at 1625ip, including people from minoritised, Muslim and male candidates, and anyone with relevant lived experience. If you need an adjustment to be made to any part of the recruitment process, please let us know as soon as possible. **Who are we?**We are a leading youth homelessness charity based in the Southwest, working with over 1,500 young people. At 1625ip we are driven by Social Justice and Passion: we strive to do something that matters and take pride in seeing the results of our work in social outcomes and improving young people’s lives. **How we work**At 1625ip our work is rooted in Psychologically Informed Environments (PIE) and Trauma-Informed Practice (TIP). Our Psychologically Informed Framework shapes how we build relationships, use our spaces, and support young people. This means we prioritise safety, trust, collaboration, and understanding the impact of trauma in every interaction. You don’t need prior experience in PIE or TIP to apply - we’ll support you to learn and develop these approaches in the role. **What you will be doing:**
* Managing or working towards managing the rent accounts for a small patch list.
* Supporting direct colleagues in addressing issues or concerns with rent accounts.
* With empathy and commitment, leading on engaging and managing rents accounts for young people who have left our service.
* Through great teamwork and attention to detail, providing administrative support for the rents team.
* By being efficient, well organised and consistent, supporting the rents team in maximising income for the organisation.
You will be in the Rents Team and your line manager will be our Senior Rents Officer.
Our Competency Development Framework sits at the heart of how we work at 1625ip. It links our values with the behaviours we expect to see in everyday practice and supports colleagues to learn, reflect and develop. It also means our recruitment is grounded in behaviours, not just experience, so applications, interviews and job profiles all focus on how we work, not only what we do.
No prior experience? No problem! We believe in your potential and are committed to providing training and support to help you thrive. If you have transferrable skills and you are interested in this role, but you are worried about the application process, please get in touch with us. We encourage you to have an informal chat with the recruiting manager to discuss how your personal or professional experience and skills could be transferred to this role. Details of how you can do that are further down in this advert. **Contract details:**
* **Hours per week:** 30 (this represents 0.8 FTE)
* **C****ontract type:** Permanent
* **Pay:** £26,824 - £28,142 (pro rata based on 0.8 FTE) NOTE: This is the current salary and does not include the NJC pay award that is currently pending. Presently, the Government / National Employers have made a pay offer of a 3.3% pay increase. Once an agreement is reached, the relevant % uplift will be backdated to the employment start date.
* **The location:** 40/41 Old Market Street. There is flexibility and support for hybrid working following the successful completion of the probation period. After the probation period, employees are expected to work from the office two days per week, with the remaining days available to work from home, subject to business needs.
**Important dates:**
* Application deadline closes: **23:59, 18 August 2026**.
* If you have not heard from us by the end of the day on **24 August 2026**, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

# Project Engineer – CAMO
**Project Engineer – CAMO**
**Doncaster**
**Permanent, full-time (Mon-Fri)**
2Excel Aviation Ltd is an industry leader in specialised and innovative solutions for aviation’s most complex challenges. Our success is based on the talented and experienced people that make up our workforce. We are seeking an CAMO Project Engineer to join its friendly Continuing Airworthiness Management Organisation (CAMO) based at Doncaster Airport. Travel to other 2Excel and/or supplier sites may be required.
Candidates should have demonstrable knowledge and experience working in a CAMO, Airworthiness or Technical Support related role as well as strong IT and communication skills. This role, whilst based at Doncaster, offers a hybrid mixture of working at home, in the office and off-site in support projects as required.
Reporting to the CAMO Project Manager, the CAMO Project Engineer’s key responsibilities will include:
* Supporting the various survey and service introduction requirements for any aircraft acquisitions into the fleet.
* Supporting the export/import requirements aircraft acquisitions including the work scope planning for bridging maintenance inputs.
* Support to aircraft surveys including the composition of aircraft survey reports.
* Technical support for aircraft modification programmes including the liaison with both Design and Maintenance Organisations.
* Support to the Management of Change process.
* Development of existing and introduction of new software/systems to support CAMO processes.
* Oversight of maintenance requirements throughout modification programmes.
* Management and control of modification documentation, data and drawings for both prototype and approved data.
* Review, assess and process incoming airworthiness data (mandatory and non-mandatory), such as AD, SB and ICA etc in line with airworthiness procedures.
* Review and update procedures and controlled forms as required to support new or revised aircraft requirements.
Candidates must have a strong understanding and knowledge of Part M/Part CAMO, Part 145 and Part 21 regulations. Experience and involvement with significant aircraft modification programmes is highly desirable. In addition, a full UK driving license is required.
Applicants must be able to demonstrate the Right to Work in the UK. Applicants must also be able to successfully pass a company sponsored Counter Terrorism Check (CTC) and/or Security Check (SC) Clearance. In addition, a full UK driving license is required.
In return we can offer you a competitive salary, upto 6% matched pension, generous holiday allowance, private health care and a company pension.

# Software Engineer
Full-time·London (Hybrid)
36 Labs is an early stage startup using AI and machine learning to optimise the world of social media marketing. We build with video and language models, from how content is conceived, to how it's generated, distributed, and optimised.
We're looking for a Software Engineer to help us build 36 Labs for the long term. Our product moves fast and the codebase has grown fast with it. AI writes a lot of what we ship, so the bottleneck isn't typing, it's judgment and taste. We need someone who can harden the foundations and keep the bar high so we keep shipping at speed as we scale.
## What you'll be doing
* Building and extending the systems that turn video and language models into content, end to end
* Designing the abstractions the team builds on, so the codebase stays an asset, not a liability, as we scale
* Looking for opportunities to reduce complexity in a fast-moving codebase: refactoring, deleting, and making the right thing the easy thing to do
* Integrating and structuring raw platform data into clean, reliable inputs: the formats our downstream systems and AI workflows depend on
* Setting the engineering standards a small team compounds on: testing, observability, CI, and code review
## What we're looking for
* Strong fundamentals in Python and TypeScript, and a track record of writing clean, well-tested production code in large codebases
* Production experience building LLM-powered systems: prompting, context engineering, RAG, agent architectures, evals
* Strong system design skills and product sense, with comfort working across SQL databases and datasets at scale
* Proficiency with AI coding tools: you get more out of them than most
* Can showcase solving hard problems with artifacts like personal projects or GitHub contributions
* Comfortable reaching into unfamiliar code across the stack to ship the right fix, and working where priorities are a moving target
* Comfortable moving fast where things are loosely defined and priorities compete; you wear several hats and own problems end-to-end
If the above doesn't line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

# Software Engineering Intern
Internship·London (Hybrid)
36 Labs is an early stage startup using AI and machine learning to optimise the world of social media marketing. We build with video and language models: how content is conceived, generated, distributed, and optimised.
We're looking for a Software Engineering Intern to build alongside us on real, in-production systems. This is an internship designed to become a full-time role. AI writes a lot of what we ship, so the bottleneck isn't typing, it's judgment and taste, and we'll help you build both fast.
## What you'll be doing
* Shipping real features into production, with an engineer close by to help you level up
* Working across the systems that turn video and language models into content, end to end
* Building and improving LLM workflows: prompting, context engineering, evals, and agents
## What we're looking for
* Solid fundamentals in Python and/or TypeScript, and projects you've built or worked on in your own time
* Genuinely excited about AI and building with LLMs, and are quick to pick up new tools
* Proficiency with AI coding tools: you often find yourself experimenting with different tools and paradigms to get the most out of the models
* Hungry and resourceful, whether you're studying, recently graduated, or self-taught
If the above doesn't line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

# Design Engineer
### Location: Rochdale (Remote Considered) | Hours: Full-time

#### **Join a Team That Puts People First**
At **A&F Sprinklers**, we’ve been delivering expert fire protection solutions for over 30 years. Our team is dynamic, professional, and committed to excellence. We invest in our people and believe in progression, training, and long-term success.
We are seeking a **Sprinkler Design Engineer** to join our growing team. You’ll be responsible for designing automatic sprinkler systems in line with industry standards and company expectations. This is a hands-on role requiring site visits, collaboration with multiple departments, and a commitment to quality and safety
‍
#### **Key Responsibilities**
As a Design Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing sprinkler systems in accordance with BSEN 12845, BS9251, NFPA, and FM Global standards. Your duties will include producing and reviewing detailed design drawings and hydraulic calculations, ensuring all designs meet project specifications and company standards.
You will attend contract handover meetings, conduct site checks to verify pipe routes and avoid clashes, and collaborate with the Design Manager to resolve any design issues. Additionally, you will prepare and issue final construction drawings to relevant stakeholders, produce “As Fitted” drawings throughout the contract, and support other departments to drive continuous improvement and contribute to overall business operations.
‍
#### **What You’ll Bring**
* Experience in designing automatic sprinkler systems.
* Knowledge of LPC/BS EN 12845, NFPA, FM Global Datasheets, and FHC rules.
* Ability to perform hydraulic calculations and work towards LPCB design qualifications.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and familiarity with design checklists and documentation processes.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to attend training and participate in company meetings and projects.
* Valid UK driving licence (if applicable).
‍
#### **What We Offer**
* **Salary -** Competitive
* **Hours** – Full-time position with flexible working hours (flexi-time), allowing you to manage your schedule while meeting project and team needs.
* **Homeworking** – Enjoy the flexibility of working from home one day per week, supporting a healthy work-life balance.
* **Leave** – 32 days of annual leave to start (including bank holidays), with additional days awarded for length of service.
* **Buy/Sell Leave** – Buy and sell additional annual leave for those well deserved trips.

The Finance Analyst, Reward and Governance plays a critical role in supporting the financial management, accounting, forecasting and governance of the Group's variable compensation and share-based payment arrangements. The successful candidate will support the financial analysis underpinning Remuneration Committee (RemCo) decision-making whilst maintaining robust controls over deferred share schemes, long-term incentive plans (LTIPs) and wider variable compensation arrangements.
The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders across the organisation, including Executive Directors, Reward specialists, Technical Accounting teams and members of the Group Finance leadership team.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Maintain and develop accounting models supporting deferred share, fund-linked and share-based payment schemes
* Calculate monthly variable compensation accounting entries
* Ensure the completeness and accuracy of remuneration accounting balances and associated reconciliations
* Support the audit process by providing calculations, evidential support and responses to audit queries
* Maintain robust controls, documentation and governance over all remuneration-related financial processes
* Develop forward-looking views of existing deferred compensation schemes and future P&L impacts
* Support annual planning, forecasting and quarterly performance review processes
* Analyse variances between actuals, forecasts and plans, identifying key drivers and emerging trends
* Support scenario modelling relating to incentive plan structures
* Maintain RemCo working files and governance documentation
* Produce analysis covering Executive Director bonuses, LTIP vesting outcomes and other incentive arrangements
* Provide financial insights and commentary to support RemCo papers
* Build effective relationships with Reward, HR, Technical Accounting, Financial Control and Business Finance teams
* Act as a trusted finance partner on variable remuneration matters
* Communicate complex financial information clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders
**About the Candidate**
The role will require an experienced individual capable of working autonomously within a complex global business. Skills and experience will need to include:
* Qualified accountant (essential)
* Understanding of financial systems and processes, in particular general ledger (essential)
* Excellent analytical ability with good attention to detail (essential)
* Asset management or financial services background (desirable)
* Experience of share-based payment accounting (IFRS 2) (desirable)
* Understanding of executive remuneration and incentive scheme structures (desirable)

## About Volunteer Safeguarding Lead (Modern Pentathlon, School Games National Finals 2026)
**What are the Schools Games National Finals:**
The School Games provides a unique experience, combining competition with the atmosphere of a multi-sport Games. This event is a fantastic opportunity for those selected athletes to compete in one of the UK's leading multi-sport events, bringing together the top young athletes from across the country in a high-performance environment. For most of the selected athletes, it is an important step in understanding the demands of major championships and performing in a high-level environment.
If you would like to understand more about the event, you can view highlights from the 2024 School Games here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hmLEl9fsRIQ
**What is the Modern Pentathlon:**
Modern Pentathlon is an Olympic multisport that challenges athletes across five disciplines: épée fencing, 100m freestyle swimming, obstacle course racing, laser pistol shooting, and running. Introduced by Olympic founder Pierre de Coubertin in 1912, it is designed to test the ultimate "complete athlete". Our sport has adapted over recent years to the exciting, fast paced event seen today.
**Key responsibilities:**
•Act as the designated point of contact for any Pentathlon safeguarding concerns arising during the event. •Provide safeguarding advice and support to athletes, staff and volunteers as required. •Liaise with the Pentathlon GB staff and event safeguarding personnel where necessary. •Be accommodated with the team throughout the event, including overnight, providing safeguarding support and oversight during the evenings and acting as the first point of contact for any safeguarding concerns arising overnight. •Support the creation of a safe, positive and athlete-centred environment throughout the event.

•Previous safeguarding experience. •Relevant safeguarding training (current or recently completed). •Ability to manage concerns appropriately and maintain confidentiality. •Enhanced DBS with Children's Barred List check •Ability to work in accordance with Pentathlon GB safeguarding policy and code of conduct. What is provided: •All accommodation, meals and transport are provided by the Schools Games team. •Specific event uniform – 2x t-shirts and 1x hoodie specific for your role. •Where transport options are not possible, travel expenses are covered. •Support prior to the event from the Pentathlon GB safeguarding and Welfare Lead, as well as the Pentathlon GB events staff. •Support from Pentathlon GB staff and Pentathlon event team throughout the event. •Opportunity to support young athletes at a major multi-sport event.

# Senior Stylist (32 hours per week) - London St Pancras
London, England, United Kingdom , Permanent
Apply now
### Store Location
Unit 11, St Pancras Station, Euston Rd, London, N1C 4QP
## The allsaints team
At AllSaints we are in the business of feelings - making our customers feel cool and confident. If, like us, you believe in the power of a great outfit, we'd love to talk to you.
We're a global brand made up of a very diverse mix of talented people in a huge variety of roles. Our products are designed in house and made by a small number of suppliers and artisans around the world to sustainable standards.
We are a brand embarking on a very exciting plan and we are seeking new members of the team who want to contribute to this.
## The role
Our senior stylists are the fundamental link between our products and customers, delivering exceptional customer service based on great product knowledge, selling skills and styling, but also through being a role model to the rest of the stylist team.
As a senior stylist you will have the opportunity to take ownership of running a floor or department, opening and closing the store, and assisting the management team in merchandising to create an engaging shopping experience. You will also support handling first line customer enquiries via our online customer service system, with the remainder of your time being spent with in-store customers.
Our senior stylists will have spent at least a year in a stylist role with us already, mastering all aspects of the stylist role across product, proposition and people and demonstrating fantastic customer centric service every day. You will be consistently demonstrating the brand values and ambition to progress at AllSaints. This role will challenge you to the next stage in your career and encourage your development through a wider scope of remit and opportunities.
## What will I be doing?
* You will be responsible for the opening/closing of the store, demonstrating confidence with cash handling, keyholding and security, deploying the team according to your store’s floor plan and delivering team briefs
* You will manage the delivery of our products, ensuring that our deliveries are efficiently processed by the team and newness hits our floors as quickly as possible for our customers
* You’ll make sure all daily tasks and requests are dealt with accurately and quickly, adhering at all times to company policies and procedures actively collaborating and sharing our values with the stylists
* You will implement best practice and ways of working within the store, mentoring new joiners to the team and demonstrating the AllSaints way of working
* You will support the brand leader and store manager with any management responsibilities, ensuring that the back of house operations are completed and standards maintained
* Learn and understand how shift rotas are organised and deployed, acting as a point of contact for any general queries from stylists if they need support
* Lead the placement of our bestsellers and key investment merchandising to entice and attract our customers
* Identify selling opportunities by actively approaching all customers with the intention of building rapport, influence styling and closing the sale
* You will handle and respond to first line customer queries, emails, chats, and calls across multiple topics relating to product and customer orders via our online customer service system
* You will be empowered to make service decisions for our customers to resolve their issue whilst retaining their loyalty and trust
* You make use of all available training material to confidently display a thorough product knowledge so that you are able to sell the AllSaints brand to the customer and upskill the stylist team
* Ensure immaculate presentation of the store at all times in terms of cleanliness, organisation and merchandising of both the sales floor and back of house areas
* You will be confident in your ability to influence and coach team members in order for them to maximise their growth within the brand
* You will be able to create an environment where you inspire others and work as one team to deliver an exceptional brand experience consistent with our brand values
* You will be predominantly store based with between 30 and 50 percent of your time spent on online customer service delivered either within the store or from time to time on a work from home basis
* You will work in partnership with our specialist customer experience team leaders, receiving coaching on service delivery and ensuring that more complex customer queries are escalated to our specialist teams promptly
## What skills do I need?
* You will need to have spent a minimum of a year in a stylist role at AllSaints before progressing to the senior stylist role
* You will be seen as a role model, already delivering great and consistent performance at stylist level with the ambition to step up into line management in the medium team
* You live and breath the AllSaints values and behaviours and can confidently explain these expectations to other members of the team
* You are confident and capable in your role and have a great understanding of AllSaints’ processes and procedures
* Your team feed off your positive attitude and have a winning mentality to get the best results
* Action orientated and solution driven to achieve results. When challenges arise, you are proactive in problem solving and resolving any issues
* Tech savvy; you'll be processing a lot of transactions and store deliveries using our in-store digital tools and responding to customer queries using our online customer service system
* Able to assert authority in a fair and consistent manner. The stylist team trust you to escalate any minor store or people issues
* Innovative and reactive to trade; you are able to quickly adapt the shop floor and focuses to meet targets and deliver exceptional customer service
* You love fashion! We need you to be an irresistible ambassador for AllSaints and a believer in the power of an amazing new outfit
## About the location
Our brand-new St Pancras store is coming soon to one of London’s busiest transport hubs, home to the Eurostar and a gateway to international travel. Set to open from 7:30 AM – 9:00 PM Monday to Saturday and 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM on Sundays, this store will be a must-stop for commuters and holiday-makers. We’re building a team that thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, bringing energy, passion, and top-tier customer service to every interaction. If you love fashion and want to be part of something exciting from the very beginning, this is the place for you

**The Customer is the Boss** We work as one proud team to get the best for our customers
**One Team** We are joined up and encourage others to share their ideas
**We Do What We Say We Will** We know our goals, and we work with clear outcomes in mind
**We Are Responsible** We are self aware, understand the impact we have on others and are positive about the future

* A generous wardrobe allowance so that you can wear our beautiful clothes to work each day
* Potential to earn more from our team commission scheme
* We are a disability committed certified employer
* Employee discount for you to spend with family and friends
* 25 days holiday increasing to 28 days after 2 years continuous service
* Bank holidays, birthdays and volunteering days off
* Access to dental cash plan & free virtual GP appointments through Aviva

About Apron
Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, but the systems they rely on are slow, manual, and built for someone else. The gap between what payments demand of an owner and their ability to actually manage them is one of the biggest reasons small businesses fail on cash flow, not on demand for their product.
Apron closes that gap. We're digitising and simplifying the entire payments process: capturing invoices, issuing expense cards, paying and getting paid, all in one place.
Founded in 2021, we've grown to ~100 people across the UK, Germany, Spain and beyond, backed by Index Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Zinal Growth and Tony Fadell, having raised $50m. The next phase isn't incremental. We're building a category-defining, global fintech business, and that requires a design team that can operate at the same level of ambition.
Why this role matters
This isn't a single-feature design job. Payments sits at the core of Apron's product: it touches nearly every other part of the system, carries the most dependencies, and is one of the highest-stakes design problems in the company right now. Getting it right means understanding not just interaction design, but the accounting domain underneath it and the reality of how SMBs actually run their finances. Every decision here has to be weighed against a system of decisions already made, and it's on you to judge when to work within that system and when it needs to be reworked. You will shape how the product works as a whole, not just how one flow feels, and have a real, visible impact on the company's revenue.
We're looking for someone genuinely energised by that level of responsibility and ambiguity.
What you'll own
End-to-end design of our core payments product, from ambiguous problem framing through to shipped, polished experiences
Interfaces for genuinely complex financial workflows that are both functional and delightful
A point of view on how the product should work as a system, brought proactively to product and engineering, not just executed on request
The design system as it applies to payments: consistency and scalability across a fast-growing surface area
Raising the bar across the design team through feedback, critique, and documented judgment
A close partnership with our UX researcher, turning user insight into decisions
What we need
Deep product design experience in complex domains where understanding the 'why' behind a decision matters as much as the decision itself.
Systems thinking; you design coordinated solutions that hold up across multiple touchpoints
Comfortable making calls on ambiguous, high-abstraction problems without someone drawing the boundaries for you
Evidence you've influenced product direction, not just shipped what was asked. We'll ask you to walk us through the why behind a decision, not just the outcome
A natural collaborator who co-leads with PMs and engineers rather than waiting for a brief
Someone who makes things look good, fast. We need speed of execution alongside strategic thinking.
How we hire
We value drive, intelligence, and current ability over pedigree. We care most about how you think and work right now. Our aim is to get an offer out within 2-3 weeks of a first conversation.
The process:
Interview with our Recruiting team
Home task, followed by a discussion with our product team. The task is built from a real problem we're actively working through, time-boxed to a few hours; we're grading your reasoning, not whether you land where we did
Team interview
Final chat with our Founder
What we offer
Highly competitive salary + stock options
Pension plan with Nest
Health insurance (including Optical and Dental cover), Life Assurance
Enhanced parental leave
Weekly Deliveroo allowance
29 days of holidays (on top of Bank holidays)
Flexible working hours
Hybrid work 3 days a week in our London (Liverpool Street) offices.
Cycle to Work scheme, Electric vehicle scheme

* Curiosity, resilience and the motivation to learn Aon’s solutions and build a long-term career in risk advisory

**About the Role** We're looking for an experienced and visionary **Print & Packaging Design Lead** to define and lead the creative direction for all physical brand experiences across packaging, print and retail environments. Reporting to the Head of Creative, you will own the creative packaging ecosystem, translating overarching brand strategy into distinctive packaging architecture, premium print execution and elevated retail experiences that strengthen the Tangle Teezer brand across every consumer touchpoint. This role sits at the intersection of creative leadership, innovation and technical excellence. You'll establish best practice across packaging design, print production and physical brand expression while driving continuous innovation across materials, finishes, sustainability and manufacturing processes. As the subject matter expert for packaging and print, you'll collaborate closely with Creative, Product Development, Commercial, Brand and external manufacturing partners to deliver world class packaging solutions from concept through to production. * Own the creative vision and long-term roadmap for packaging, print and physical brand experiences across all product categories and global markets.

* Define and evolve the brand's packaging architecture, establishing systems, principles and design standards that create consistency whilst allowing innovation across the portfolio.
* Lead concept development for new packaging formats, structures and consumer experiences that differentiate the brand within the premium beauty category.
**Packaging Design & Innovation**
* Lead the creative development of all packaging from initial concept through artwork, production and final manufacture.
* Develop packaging architecture, layout systems, hierarchy, typography, materials and premium finishes that elevate product desirability and reinforce the brand identity.
* Create physical mock-ups, prototypes and presentation visuals to communicate design intent, test functionality and refine consumer experiences prior to production.

* Research emerging packaging trends, technologies and consumer behaviours to continually evolve the physical brand experience.
**Production Excellence**
* Oversee artwork creation and production, ensuring all files are technically accurate including dielines, cutter guides, colour management, Pantone specifications, finishes and print requirements.
* Lead colour approvals, print passes, production sign-offs and quality assurance across global suppliers, ensuring exceptional execution throughout manufacture.
* Partner closely with Product Development, Commercial and external manufacturing partners to ensure all creative solutions are commercially viable, manufacturable and delivered to the highest quality standards.
* Manage relationships with printers, packaging suppliers and production partners, ensuring consistency, quality and continuous improvement across all production outputs.
**Retail & Visual Merchandising**
* Lead the creative development of retail experiences including point of sale, window displays, promotional materials, event collateral and retail graphics to maximise product visibility and consumer engagement.
* Partner with Product Development and Commercial teams to develop structural packaging solutions, secondary packaging, retail displays and promotional glorifiers that enhance storytelling and strengthen shelf presence.
* Ensure all physical touchpoints create a seamless and premium consumer experience across retail, wholesale and owned channels.
**Leadership & Collaboration**
* Establish and maintain global packaging and artwork standards, ensuring consistency across all product categories and international markets.
* Mentor and develop designers across the creative team, providing technical guidance, creative feedback and packaging expertise while helping raise overall creative standards.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships across Creative, Brand, Product Development, Commercial and Supply Chain to ensure packaging supports both creative ambition and commercial success.
* Act as the creative authority for all packaging and print, confidently presenting concepts and influencing senior stakeholders throughout the development process.
* Help shape the future evolution of the Tangle Teezer brand through continual innovation in packaging, print and physical consumer experiences.

* Outstanding portfolio demonstrating premium packaging, print, retail and physical brand experience.
* Proven experience leading packaging programmes from concept through to global production.
* Demonstrated experience developing packaging systems and physical brand identities across multiple product categories.

* Strong understanding of structural packaging, packaging engineering principles and retail merchandising.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Product Development, Commercial, Brand Marketing and external manufacturing partners.

**Role purpose**
The Pursuit and Proposal Senior Manager (Tax team) is the lead pursuit coach for the firm’s largest and most complex bids, accountable for shaping and executing the overall approach to winning. The role partners with pursuit leads and senior stakeholders to develop win strategy, win themes and differentiation, and to ensure the team’s pitch and presentation approach is compelling, rehearsed and aligned to the written submission.
This role is coaching-led. It drives disciplined pursuit governance (go/no-go inputs, probability-to win thinking, milestone reviews), influences the pursuit team’s behaviours and decisions, and elevates how the firm shows up to buyers. The role may work alongside a proposal manager
supporting production but remains accountable for the strategic “win it” approach and for increasing win likelihood on priority pursuits aligned to growth and market priorities.
**Key responsibilities**
* Shape win strategy, win themes and “how we win” narrative based on buyer needs, decision dynamics and competitive context.
* Challenge and strengthen differentiation, proof points and risk handling, ensuring the case to win is clear and evidenced.
* Coach pursuit leads and senior stakeholders to improve pursuit behaviours, decision-making and quality of execution.
* Facilitate key pursuit working sessions to align teams around the strategy, storyline and roles.
* Lead pitch preparation and rehearsal approach: narrative structure, choreography, speaking roles, audience targeting and QandA readiness.
* Advise on and enforce pursuit milestones and review gates (strategy, storyline, draft quality and readiness checks).
* Identify risks early (strategy, evidence gaps, capability, time) and escalate with recommendations.
* Work with Content/Markets Activation/Design and Bid Hub Knowledge colleagues to ensure proposals and pitches use the best available assets and proof points.
* Contribute to win/loss debriefs and convert learning into improvements in coaching approach, templates and playbooks.
* Provide insight into pursuit pipeline and readiness for reporting and prioritisation.
**You'll be someone with**
* Significant experience leading high-value, complex bids and pitches in a professional services or complex B2B environment.
* Strong track record of improving win performance through strategy, coaching and disciplined rehearsal.
* Excellent facilitation and senior stakeholder influence skills.
* Strong commercial judgement and ability to assess probability-to-win and readiness.
* High editorial/storytelling capability with strong buyer orientation.

emerging business and technology trends (e.g., hybrid cloud, edge

decision-making by providing insight into the long-term implications of

operational excellence

enterprise infrastructure architecture frameworks and strategies that are

architects, DevOps, and platform teams to ensure infrastructure is
integrated across the delivery lifecycle, supporting agility, security,
and performance.

infrastructure technologies and assess their potential impact on the
enterprise architecture landscape.

transitional, and target states of infrastructure architecture, enabling

platforms.

services and platforms to reduce duplication, optimise costs, and ensure

lifecycle of infrastructure assets, ensuring they remain fit-for-purpose,
cost-effective, and aligned with evolving business needs.

technologies including compute, storage, networking, virtualisation (e.g.,

* Attention to detail and a
commitment to delivering high-quality work.

infrastructure or cloud architecture certifications (e.g., Microsoft

Coaching and mentoring team

**Company Description**
HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.
HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”.Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).
The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally, offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.

The team works closely with Product Specialist, Investor Relations, Fund Accounting, Operations, Valuation, Deal Execution, and Technology teams.
**Position Description** HPS is currently seeking an Associate level candidate to join our Portfolio Analytics & Reporting team to focus on the PFS Private Credit platform.

Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:
* Monitor, track and analyze performance at the investment, portfolio and fund level.
* Create and update client portfolio reports (monthly/quarterly/ ad hoc); prepare ongoing and ad hoc investor data requests, fund performance queries and reports, while collaborating with Valuation, Fund Accounting and Investor Relations teams.
* Ensure the on-going quality and accuracy of performance reporting, maintain the integrity of internal processes and databases used to track key performance and investment metrics at the investment, and portfolio levels including industry, sector, country, investment type, market cap, leverage, and regional exposures, etc.
* Assist in the operational due diligence of existing and potential new investors
* Coordinate and interact with investor relations, compliance, portfolio managers, and operations around new product launches, servicing clients, and delivering custom requests

* Bachelors degree in relevant Business related field (Finance, Economics, Accounting, etc)

* A strong understanding of credit and financial markets
* Strong knowledge of accounting and finance
* Exceptionally strong excel skills
* Strong organizational and process management skills
* A demonstrated strong work ethic and desire to work in a collaborative, small team environment
* Python and SQL knowledge is a plus

* 4/1 split (F work from home, M-Th work from office.)

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Our Interdependent Brand Clusters (Bolster Momentum; Accelerate & Stepchange; Seed for the Future) and our Make It A Double ambition require an agile and flexible approach to Customer Marketing. The Channel Customer Marketing Manager is a key member of the Sales Team, reporting into the Head of Customer Marketing. The role partners with Sales channels in developing compelling consumer and customer centric marketing plans across a portfolio of brands, which will deliver against commercial targets in a competitive environment. The role requires managing the short and medium-term value and forming strategic relationships with key customers and internal stakeholders.
The role will require demonstrating building the customer marketing capabilities of the team as well as ensuring that your team meets key customer planning cycles and delivers insight driven activation which maximizes value and ROI to the business, the consumer and the customer. The role requires the ability to build relationships across the business and work in collaboration with marketing, sales, purchasing, finance and category teams. Success for this position is dependent on a strong drive to deliver progressive, tangible results, excellence in communication and influencing skills and bold, entrepreneurial thinking. The Manager, Programme Analytics – SRHR will play a central role in helping CIFF’s SRHR leadership make better, faster and more evidence-informed decisions across one of the foundation’s largest and most strategically important portfolios. SRHR is a team of more than 20 people, managing over 150 contracts of over USD 1 billion. Programme managers and analysts are responsible for programme analytics, alongside all their other responsibilities. People living with dementia who are also diagnosed with cancer face some of the starkest inequalities in Scottish
health care. Serious symptoms get put down to dementia rather than investigated. Cancer is picked up late.
Treatment decisions happen at speed, in unfamiliar settings, with little support to understand information or
express what matters. We think communities can change that, and we are looking for the person to lead the
work.
Meeting Centres Scotland is the national charity behind Scotland's network of Meeting Centres: welcoming, local
places where people living with dementia and their families find support to adjust to change and keep living
well in their communities. Our network has grown to around 47 centres across 17 local authority areas, reaching
more than 1,000 people every month.

Centres to support people through diagnosis, treatment and beyond. You will build referral and liaison pathways
with Health Boards, Health and Social Care Partnerships, Macmillan professionals and oncology teams, and lead a
rights based influencing strand that puts diagnostic overshadowing and shared decision making on the agenda of
cancer services and planners.
We are looking for an experienced project manager who is at home facilitating a room where people with dementia,
family carers and clinicians sit as equal partners; who can hold a national, multi strand project together; and
who believes that a dementia diagnosis should never be a barrier to good cancer care. Experience across both
dementia and cancer is welcome but by no means required. Values, facilitation skill and delivery ability matter
most.

Team-level Role

* Using good judgment and skill to develop a project management approach that is suitable for planning and managing the effort.

* Managing multiple concurrent projects and programmes of varying size and complexity across strategic customer accounts.

* Proven track record of working with business analyst and full stack developers.

Location: Andover

Purpose of role
To lead the archaeological direction and site management of larger and more complex fieldwork sites and projects, ensuring performance targets are met (or exceeded), and assuring the quality of archaeological recording and understanding.
Main duties and responsibilities:
* Site responsibility for managing the delivery of fieldwork to time, budget, quality and health and safety requirements.
* Line manage and develop staff, ensuring their continuous improvement in performance through performance reviews, constructive feedback, initiating training, coaching and improved practices.
* Assure the quality of archaeological understanding and site records, and oversee the compilation of archaeological archives to required standards.
* Author typescript fieldwork reports, stratigraphic accounts, and fieldwork summaries efficiently and accurately.
* Monitor and provide regular reports to Project Managers on project progress (budgetary and archaeological), logistical, staff and health and safety issues, and to maintain appropriate liaison with clients, Local Government officers, and contractors.
* Ensure accurate completion and approval of appropriate administrative records, including timesheets, and allocation sheets.
* Ensure effective deployment, maintenance and care of vehicles, plant and equipment, and maintain/provide accurate records ensuring accidents, damage and malfunctions are reported promptly and appropriately.
* Ensure fieldwork is carried out in accordance with Actively promote, and develop a greater public awareness and appreciation of the work of CA through displays, publications, contributions to the website, media liaison, lectures etc.
* Assist Project Managers in pre-project planning and preparation including undertaking the preparation of written schemes of investigation, trench plans, obtaining service information, notifying utility companies prior to excavation and making appropriate contact with landowners and agents and other relevant parties.
* Deputise for the Senior Project Officer or Project Manager where appropriate.
* Contribute to departmental processes and working practices via Learning Reports, feedback to Committee Representatives and/or project leaders, and discussion at performance reviews.
* Actively promote, and develop a greater public awareness and appreciation of the work of CA through displays, publications, contributions to the website, media liaison, lectures etc.
* Undertake additional duties appropriate to the role as required.
Personal specification
Essential
* Knowledge and expertise in archaeological practice, including a general familiarity with the archaeology of Britain at all periods.
* Experience of the supervision of large fieldwork projects (including excavations and large-scale/complex evaluations).
* The ability to write clear and accurate fieldwork reports, stratigraphic accounts and fieldwork summaries.
* Good communication skills and the ability to organise, motivate, train, appraise and direct staff.
* Knowledge, awareness and understanding of business needs, budgets and timescales, within commercial archaeology.
* Good working knowledge of all relevant Health and Safety requirements, and other relevant legislation.
* The ability to communicate efficiently and courteously with sponsors and clients of CA, officers of other bodies and members of the public.
* Administrative ability in the keeping of records and accounts and the submission of reports.
* A full manual driving licence is essential, as is the ability and willingness to drive company vehicles (4x4, vans and minibuses)
* Proficient in Microsoft applications – including word-processing, excel and database skills
* Competent in carrying out first aid.
Desirable
* Membership of the Chartered Institute for Archaeologists or willingness to join on appointment.
* Demonstrable potential to competently author, or contribute to, reports/articles for publication.
* In depth knowledge or expertise in a particular archaeological period, site type or subject (such as finds or environmental archaeology, survey or GIS).
* Survey skills, including ability to operate Leica GPS/TST, and basic knowledge and understanding of CAD.
* Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass.

## Job Description
**Commercial Finance Director – Revenue Performance, Pricing & Commercial Execution** **Business Unit:** Global Financial Solutions ("GFS") **Location:** London, United Kingdom or Wilmington, United States **Job Type:** Permanent, Hybrid (3 days onsite) **Hours:** Full time
**About the Role**
The GFS Commercial Finance Director partners with business leaders and the Revenue & Strategy Head to operationalize commercial priorities, strengthen pricing discipline, and improve contribution margin across GFS. This role provides clear, actionable insight on revenue performance, client profitability, pricing outcomes, and commercial execution risks. You will lead governance for the global annual fee increase program and support strategic commercial decisions across renewals, growth initiatives, and key accounts. The role works closely with Finance Business Partners, Sales & Markets, Operations, and Technology while maintaining clear boundaries from revenue assurance and billing operations.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the global annual fee increase program across GFS, including governance, calendar, business engagement, tracking, and benefits reporting
* Partner with CFO, Revenue & Strategy, and business leaders to set annual fee increase targets, guardrails, and approval expectations
* Drive accountability for identifying eligible clients, proposed uplifts, exceptions, approvals, and timely completion; report on misses, delays, and leakage
* Collaborate with Commercial Finance Operations / Revenue Assurance to ensure approved fee changes are implemented accurately in systems and reflected in billing (while retaining ownership of outcomes and reporting)
* Translate agreed Revenue & Strategy priorities into executable plans with measurable actions; support performance reviews with insight, action tracking, and follow-through
* Provide forward-looking analysis on revenue trends, product penetration, client growth, pricing quality, margin impact, and execution risks to support budget and reforecast cycles
* Operate and evolve pricing governance across GFS, including pricing principles, approval routes, margin guardrails, and decision materials for strategic deals, renewals, and bundled propositions
* Challenge discounting and margin dilution with fact-based recommendations; monitor discount trends and pricing performance to reinforce commercial discipline
* Support strategic account planning with profitability, cost-to-serve, and pricing analysis; identify margin expansion and cross-sell opportunities and prioritize activity by value and deliverability
* Improve commercial MI and dashboards in partnership with Technology and Data teams; convert complex data into practical recommendations for leaders.
**Required Experience**
* Significant commercial finance experience in financial services, fund services, professional services, or a complex global B2B environment
* Demonstrated expertise in pricing governance, margin management, profitability analysis, and commercial decision support
* Experience leading or supporting annual fee increase governance and execution across multiple regions/business lines
* Strong analytical skills with ability to translate data into action-oriented insights and clear executive-level narratives
* Proven stakeholder influence in a matrix organization, including the ability to challenge constructively and drive accountability
* Experience partnering across Finance, Revenue & Strategy, Sales, Operations, and Technology with clear ownership boundaries.
**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with contract-to-cash concepts, commercial billing impacts, and revenue leakage prevention (governance/insight perspective)
* Strong commercial MI, dashboarding, and performance tracking experience (e.g., client profitability, contribution margin, pricing outcomes)
* Exposure to strategic account planning frameworks and commercial modeling for cross-sell and wallet-share expansion
* Experience working in a global operating model with multiple service lines and regional leadership structures.

## About CuspAI
CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. **We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.**
## The Role
Due to rapid company growth and expanding external data partnerships, we are seeking a Materials Knowledge Architect to join our Data team and lead the design of our scientific data representations, schemas, and ingestion pipelines.
## Your impact
This is an exciting opportunity to join the data team at CuspAI, working closely with world-leading AI experts and materials science researchers to design the data models and ingestion pipelines that turn heterogeneous external data into actionable data assets. Much of the data that powers our models arrives in different formats, schemas and standards. As a Materials Knowledge Architect you will own how that data is represented, modelled and brought into CuspAI, and be foundational in ensuring its quality at scale so it can fuel the discovery of the next generation of materials.
## What You Will Do
**Data Architecture & Schema Design**
* Design the data models that represent chemical, structural and materials property information, and define how diverse external sources map onto a coherent, interoperable internal representation.
* Establish and own data quality, validation, deduplication, lineage and provenance frameworks so that every ingested dataset is trustworthy, traceable and ML-ready.
* Use your expertise in chemistry, physics and/or materials science to maximise the quality, scale and consistency of data flowing in from external sources.
**Ingestion & Data Pipeline Execution**
* Lead the ingestion of data from partners — industrial collaborators, instrument and simulation vendors, research institutions and commercial data providers — building robust pipelines that normalise, harmonise and reconcile data arriving in varied formats and standards.
* Contribute to the data team's efforts to identify, evaluate and assess new data sources, partnerships and data generation opportunities, including computational (e.g. DFT, molecular dynamics) and experimental campaigns.
**Partner & Interdisciplinary Collaboration**
* Partner directly with external data providers to understand their data, agree formats and standards, define schema mappings, and resolve quality, provenance and interoperability issues at the source.
* Work in partnership across research and engineering teams to translate modelling needs into ingestion requirements and ML-ready datasets.
* Communicate your work and raise awareness of opportunities to improve data models, ingestion processes and overall data quality.
## Must Have Skills and Qualifications:
* Proven experience designing data models and schemas for complex scientific or technical domains, and curating high-quality data assets from them.
* Demonstrable experience ingesting, integrating and harmonising data from multiple external sources or partners, each with differing formats, schemas and quality levels.
* PhD in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Computational Chemistry or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.
* Expert in data representation, ontologies, data modelling and the curation of high-quality, interoperable data assets.
* Experience working with a broad range of data types used in materials discovery — especially experimental and characterization data (e.g. synthesis parameters and processing conditions, XRD patterns, spectroscopy, adsorption isotherms, device measurements) alongside computed properties (e.g. DFT-derived formation energies, band gaps) — and mapping them across heterogeneous sources.
* Deep knowledge of materials and chemical data sources spanning both experimental and computational domains (e.g. ICSD, the Cambridge Structural Database, NOMAD, Materials Project), and of the practical challenges of harmonizing lab-generated data — instrument outputs, ELN/LIMS records, unit conventions, provenance — into interoperable, ML-ready assets.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL with experience building data pipelines for experimental and computational data, including schema/data-model design (e.g. Pydantic, JSON Schema) and familiarity with materials and data science toolkits (e.g. pymatgen, ASE, Pandas/Polars).
* Firsthand experience with how experimental data is actually produced — lab workflows, instrument quirks, incomplete metadata — and pragmatic strategies for modeling it faithfully rather than forcing it into idealized schemas.
* Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partners as well as multidisciplinary chemistry/physics/materials and product/engineering teams.
## Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

**Remembering Yesterday Caring Today**
A reminiscence project for people living with dementia and their carers.
For over 20 years, our Remembering Yesterday, Caring Today (RYCT) groups have been bringing people’s memories to life- from schooldays and work to travel and home life.
Through art, music and conversation, we create a fun and welcoming space to spark joy and connection for everyone.
**Training in Reminiscence Arts in Dementia Care**
The European Reminiscence Network announces a new Training Course and Apprenticeship Scheme in Reminiscence Arts in Dementia Care – in partnership with the University of Greenwich.
This 2-day training course and apprenticeship scheme will be of interest to arts practitioners, community arts workers, oral historians, occupational and arts therapists, group workers, reminiscence practitioners, staff from health and social care services who are interested and/or experienced in positive approaches to dementia care.
**A. 2-Day Training Course in Reminiscence Arts in Dementia Care**
You are invited to apply for a 2-day training course to be held at the Argenta House, Camden.
* Venue: Argenta House, 1 Aspern Grove, Camden, London NW3 2AB
* Dates: Thursday 17th & Friday 18th September 2026
* Time: 9:30 – 17:00 on both days. A light lunch will be served.
This experiential course will be led by highly experienced reminiscence arts practitioners and trainers, with input from volunteers and former carers. It will be certificated by the European Reminiscence Network.
**B. 4-Month Apprenticeship Scheme in Reminiscence Arts in Dementia Care**
Up to ten places are available for trainees on the above course to join our apprenticeship scheme for people who wish to become accredited facilitators of reminiscence groups for people living with dementia and their carers.
The apprenticeship scheme involves attending, observing and participating in at least 6 out of 10 weekly group sessions of the RYCT project with local people living with dementia and their family carers. The 10 weekly sessions will be held on Friday afternoons at Argenta House, Belsize Park from 25th September 2026.
Those who wish to become European Reminiscence Network accredited facilitators of RYCT will also be required to give evidence of their ability to observe and reflect on the project through a written response, or an audio or video diary capturing their experience of the project, reflecting on the content and impact of the sessions and how far they have met the needs of the participating families. Those successfully completing these requirements will receive accreditation as RYCT facilitators from the European Reminiscence Network. Further details are available on request.
The training and apprenticeship scheme is part of a 10-country partnership, sharing and developing the European Reminiscence Network’s experience of running this successful project for more than 20 years.
See:
* https://www.instagram.com/r\_y\_c\_t/
* www.rememberingyesterdaycaringtoday.com
* www.europeanreminiscencenetwork.org
**Fees and Subsidies**
The cost of the 2-day training is £120, and for those joining the apprenticeship scheme, there will be a further £120 fee towards the support and evaluation provided by course leaders. We offer 4 subsidised training spaces and 2 subsidised apprentice places at half the above costs for anyone living or working in Camden. With an additional 2 training and 2 apprentice places reserved for our project partners: Camden Carers Centre and Age UK Camden.
**Applying**
If you wish to apply, please contact us at information.ryct.projects@gmail.com, indicating your skills and interest in the training course – or the training and apprenticeship scheme. You are welcome to include a CV. Please note: if we have your CV or expression of interest, there is no need to resend this.

Our focus is on delivering exceptional customer services to the professional and financial services sector, including leading private equity and venture capital firms and several top 10 UK law firms.

## About The Role
We are looking for an experienced Head of Paid Media and Social Media to lead customer acquisition, social media strategy, content strategy and conversion optimisation across our group of brands.
The role will be primarily focused on Ecotalk, with additional support across Ecotricity Domestic, Skydiamond, Dale Vince campaigning and other group brands as required.
This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who combines strategic thinking, high creativity, commercial judgement and strong paid social platform expertise. You will turn brand plans and commercial priorities into effective paid media, social media, content and conversion activity that delivers measurable results.
You will lead a team setting the standard for best-in-class digital channel customer acquisition, with a dominant focus on paid and organic social media strategy and execution. You will also bring experience across broader paid media, content strategy and conversion optimisation, working closely with direct reports, Brand Marketing Managers, Dale Vince’s campaign team, creative teams, PR and relevant business stakeholders.
You will not own the complete marketing or commercial strategy for each brand, own the customer proposition, brand positioning or total brand budget. Your role is to provide specialist leadership and hands-on execution across acquisition, primarily for Ecotalk through paid social media platforms, while providing social media leadership across group brands and team leadership across other paid media channels, content and conversion. You will ensure activity is joined up, audience-led and commercially effective.
******Core responsibilities:******
### Lead paid media and acquisition
You will directly lead paid media and customer acquisition strategy for Ecotalk, and then provide direction across agreed group brands. You will have experience of paid search, price comparison websites, referrals, affiliates and other acquisition channels.
You will:
* Turn brand and commercial objectives into clear channel plans, budgets, forecasts and performance targets.
* Lead the planning, delivery and optimisation of acquisition campaigns.
* Ensure investment decisions are based on customer acquisition cost, customer quality, conversion and lifetime value.
* Develop structured testing across audiences, creative, messaging, bidding, channels and landing pages.
* Identify opportunities to improve channel mix, efficiency and commercial return.
* Lead internal specialists and agency partners to deliver high-quality, accountable activity.
* Use platform automation and appropriate AI tools to support planning, audience development, creative testing, optimisation and analysis, while maintaining clear human oversight and commercial control.
### Shape social media and content strategy
You will own integrated social media and content strategy across agreed brands and channels, delivered through the Content Manager and Social and Content Editor, and in close partnership with Dale Vinces campaign team. Your focus will be to develop activity that supports brand awareness, audience growth, engagement, customer education, acquisition, conversion and campaigning.
You will:
* Ensure paid and organic social media work together effectively.
* Develop platform-specific social and content plans.
* Use audience insight, search behaviour, social listening and performance data to identify opportunities.
* Improve the way content is adapted, repurposed and amplified across paid, owned and social channels.
* Ensure content supports paid campaigns, search visibility, landing pages and customer journeys.
* Keep the team responsive to changes in platforms, audience behaviour and content formats.
* Measure activity against clear brand, audience and commercial objectives.
* Use AI and other appropriate tools to support research, trend identification, content planning, briefing, repurposing and analysis, while ensuring final output remains accurate, distinctive, brand-appropriate and guided by strong editorial judgement.
### Improve conversion
You will own conversion strategy and CRO testing across paid media, landing pages and relevant acquisition journeys.
You will work with product, UX, technology, data and commercial teams to identify barriers to conversion and prioritise improvements.
This will include:
* Developing a structured programme of conversion tests.
* Creating clear hypotheses, measurement plans and commercial rationale.
* Improving landing pages, forms, switching journeys and campaign journeys.
* Using customer behaviour and performance data to identify opportunities.
* Sharing test results and applying successful approaches across future activity.
### ### Manage performance and investment
You will take responsibility for the commercial performance of the channels and activity within your remit.
You will manage relevant budgets, maintain clear visibility of planned and actual spend, and provide straightforward reporting and recommendations to all stakeholders.
You will:
* Monitor performance against KPIs, forecasts, budgets and commercial objectives.
* Identify underperformance, risks and opportunities early.
* Recommend changes to investment based on evidence and commercial priorities.
* Explain not only what happened, but why it happened and what action should follow.
* Use performance insight to improve targeting, creative, content, conversion and budget allocation.
* Ensure media and agency expenditure is transparent, controlled, and actively optimised.

You will be commercially focused, analytical and confident using data to make decisions. You will understand what makes creative and content effective, while remaining focused on customer behaviour, conversion and return on investment.
You will be curious about new technology and willing to test better ways of working, without losing the human judgement, creativity and brand sensitivity that strong marketing requires.
You will be collaborative, organised and comfortable working through complexity. Most importantly, you will share our belief in the power of green energy, nature and sustainable business to change markets for the better.

## **About Electric Twin**
Most organisations make their biggest decisions on a thin slice of evidence — a handful of customer calls, one survey, instinct when the data runs out. Electric Twin changes that. We're a behavioural simulation platform that lets organisations test ideas, messages, and decisions against synthetic populations — digital twins of real audiences — and get answers in minutes that would otherwise take weeks.

About the Role
We're looking for a Data Scientist to build the Murphy’s brain — the ML that decides who we contact, when, how and how often, to recover the most debt inside hard legal limits. Recovery is a data problem before it's a voice problem, and you own the data problem. This is one of the highest-leverage seats in the company: your models set the strategy every AI agent executes, on every call.
Murphy builds AI voice agents that collect overdue debt for banks: more recovered, faster, cheaper, fully compliant, and respectful to the debtor. Own the contact strategy. Who Murphy contacts, when, how often, on which channel — voice, WhatsApp, etc. — to maximise recovery inside hard legal guardrails.
Model the debtor. Propensity and uplift models — who picks up, who pays, who responds to which voice, script or offer — turned into live segments the agents act on.

You hold a degree in mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or computer science.

**Faculty of Engineering and Applied Sciences**

We welcome applications from ambitious and innovative scientists to help develop next-generation biotechnology solutions for tackling PFAS pollution through artificial intelligence-assisted enzyme engineering.
An exciting opportunity to work as a Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) Associate has arisen as part of a collaboration project between Inspiralis Ltd and Cranfield University. The project will focus on developing an AI-assisted enzyme engineering platform for the design, production and validation of enzymes capable of degrading per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), commonly known as ‘forever chemicals’.
**About the Role**
Your role will lead the development of an AI-assisted enzyme engineering approach capable of designing and manufacturing tailored enzymes that can effectively break down PFAS pollutants, protect drinking water supplies, reduce environmental pollution, and support more sustainable and cost-effective remediation solutions.
You will work between Inspiralis Ltd and the UKRI-sponsored Environmental Biotechnology Innovation Centre (EBIC) hosted at Cranfield University. The role offers a unique opportunity to gain experience across industrial biotechnology, environmental science and commercial innovation, while contributing to the development of a new environmental biotechnology platform with significant commercial potential.
**About You**
This role requires knowledge of enzyme engineering, molecular biology and protein expression, along with strong data analysis and environmental biotechnology experiences. Knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, bioinformatics, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, or PFAS chemistry would also be desirable.
This role would suit an individual with excellent communication and project management skills, and the ability to work effectively across both academic and industrial environments. Previous experience of molecular biology, protein engineering, enzyme characterisation or related laboratory techniques is essential. You will hold a PhD, or be close to completion, in Biotechnology, Synthetic Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Environmental Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

As a specialist postgraduate university, Cranfield’s world-class expertise, large-scale facilities and unrivalled industry partnerships are creating leaders in technology and management globally. Learn more about Cranfield and our unique impact here.
The Environmental Biotechnology Innovation Centre (EBIC) is a UKRI-funded Engineering Biology Mission Hub hosted at Cranfield University that brings together leading academic and industrial partners to develop biotechnology solutions for environmental challenges. Learn more about EBIC here.
You will be based primarily at Inspiralis Ltd, an established UK biotechnology company with more than 17 years of successful trading, specialising in the development and manufacture of molecular biology enzymes. The company is based at Norwich Research Park and has a multidisciplinary team of scientists and technical specialists, and it supplies high-quality enzyme products and services to customers across the UK and international life science sectors. You will work closely with Dr Nicolas Burton (CTO) and Dr Natassja Bush (CEO) and the Inspiralis team, as well as a multidisciplinary team of academics from EBIC at Cranfield University to develop innovative AI-assisted enzyme technologies for PFAS remediation.

**About the FCA**
The Financial Conduct Authority is the conduct regulator for nearly 42,000 financial services firms and financial markets in the UK and the prudential supervisor for 41,000 firms, setting specific standards for 17,000 firms.
The FCA’s strategic objective is to make sure relevant markets function well and has outlined how it will achieve this in its 5-year strategy. It also has a secondary objective to facilitate the international competitiveness and growth of the UK economy in the medium to long term.
**The role of the Panel**
The Panel is established under statute and is independent of the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA). It represents the interests of consumers of financial services (including small business consumers) to the FCA. Its vision is for financial services markets to work well for consumers. Its role is to ensure that the consumer interest is considered as part of the FCA’s policy development and implementation.
Panel members offer constructive advice and challenge to help the FCA deliver its strategic and operational objectives throughout the policy cycle. They engage directly with the FCA at all levels, including the Chair, CEO and Executive Committee, to help shape the regulator’s policies, rules and responses to emerging issues that affect financial services consumers and small businesses. Through this work, Panel members have a genuine opportunity to influence regulatory thinking and improve outcomes for consumers across the UK. The Panel is supported by a Secretariat provided by the FCA.
