# Digital Service Manager
## Join LAB as Digital Service Manager: lead client‐focused product support, coordinate teams, ensure reliable, proactive digital services. Remote‐friendly with growth, impact, and collaboration.
# **DIGITAL SERVICE MANAGER**
**Location:** Remote with occasional travel to our head office in Maidstone, Kent or a venue in London.
If you are looking for hybrid working, offices are based in Maidstone and Leamington Spa.
**Salary:** £35,000-£45,000
**Job Type:** Full time
## **About LAB**
We’re a company that cares about the humans behind the tech.
At LAB, we believe in the power of digital to reshape the world for good. That belief drives the work we do every day, and we're proud to support our team as they create innovative solutions that make a real impact for our clients.
As part of the Human First Collective, alongside Reflect Digital (digital marketing) and Aspiration Digital (our non-profit digital skills conference for students), we’ve built a culture that encourages people to love what they do and do what they love. We’re deeply committed to the growth and development of our people, and we take pride in creating an environment where everyone can thrive.
Our shared mission is grounded in a deep understanding of human behaviour, which we apply to the design and delivery of digital solutions that challenge the norm and help reshape the digital world. With a broad portfolio of work, from major household brands to disruptive startups, and internal initiatives aimed at making the world a better place, every day brings new challenges, opportunities, and inspiration.
### **Our Core Values**
**Our values are the driving force behind our business success, empowering our team to make informed decisions with integrity:**
* **People First. Always:** We truly believe our agency is only as strong as our team. We lead with empathy, transparency, and high trust, respecting boundaries and treating everyone with dignity. To us, data isn't just numbers on a screen; it represents real people and families.
* **Growth Fuelled by Curiosity:** We don’t just accept a brief; we interrogate it. Curiosity drives our growth mindset, pushing us to challenge assumptions, prioritise critical thinking over rigid processes, and learn fast.
* **We Win Together:** Success is a shared victory. We operate as a true extension of our clients’ teams, balancing individual freedom with open collaboration to produce award-winning work with real-world impact.
## **The Role**
The Digital Service Manager leads the delivery of our high-quality product support function, ensuring clients receive responsive, reliable, and proactive support across websites, software, and digital products.
Acting as the central point of coordination between clients, developers, delivery teams, and quality assurance, you will combine technical understanding with exceptional client service. You’ll manage support operations, service levels, release processes, and application maintenance agreements to ensure our digital products remain stable, secure, and continually improving.
## **Key Responsibilities**
#### **Product Support & Service Delivery**
* Lead the day-to-day operation of the agency's product support function across multiple client accounts.
* Manage incoming support requests, carrying out initial investigation, troubleshooting, and issue triage.
* Prioritise support requests based on business impact, urgency, and contractual service levels (SLAs).
* Raise detailed bug tickets within Jira, thoroughly documenting replication steps, supporting evidence, and technical context for development teams.
* Coordinate development resource allocation for swift investigation and resolution of support issues.
* Monitor support queues continuously to ensure issues progress efficiently from initial triage through to final resolution.
* Work closely with developers and QA to validate fixes before releasing them to live environments.
* Share responsibility for the agency's on-call support rotation, ensuring critical client issues are managed promptly and professionally.
#### **Service Management & Continuous Improvement**
* Monitor support contract budgets and manage development resource bookings within agreed allocations.
* Track, measure, and report against Support SLA performance, identifying trends and opportunities for service refinement.
* Collaborate with Project Managers, Technical, and QA Teams to continuously improve support processes, tooling, and ways of working.
* Identify recurring technical issues and recommend long-term product improvements that reduce ongoing support demand.
* Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and support playbooks that improve consistency across the entire team.
* Support the renewal and ongoing operational management of Application Maintenance Agreement (AMA) contracts.
* Work with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements across support delivery.
#### **Release & Change Management**
* Schedule regular business-as-usual (BAU) release cycles in close collaboration with technical teams.
* Facilitate release planning meetings and coordinate all deployment activities.
* Support the execution of regression testing to protect product quality before live deployment.
* Produce clear, user-friendly release notes and communicate upcoming changes effectively to clients.
* Ensure all releases are delivered in a structured, predictable, and low-risk manner.
#### **Client Relationship Management**
* Act as a primary, trusted point of contact for ongoing product support queries.
* Host weekly or bi-weekly client meetings to review priorities, recently released work, and current blockers.
* Represent the product support function during wider client meetings, service reviews, and project updates.
* Provide clear, timely, and proactive updates on issue progress, release schedules, and overall service performance.
* Build client confidence through a customer-first approach and clear expectation management throughout the support lifecycle.
#### **Personal Growth & Team Collaboration**
* Stay informed about emerging technologies, service management practices, and digital platforms.
* Continually develop technical understanding of the agency's products, CMS platforms, and supporting technologies.
* Seek opportunities to improve service management, technical knowledge, and client delivery skills.
* Share knowledge with colleagues and actively participate in team discussions focused on operational excellence.
## **What We’re Looking For**
* **Customer Focus:** A track record of delivering high standards of service, understanding client needs, and building trusted long-term relationships.
* **Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking:** A methodical approach to investigating technical issues, identifying root causes, and coordinating solutions across multi-disciplinary teams.
* **Service Management Experience:** Solid experience managing support requests, SLAs, budgets, and operational workflows (experience with Jira is a big plus).
* **Technical Awareness:** A good understanding of web technologies, CMS platforms, and digital development processes to bridge the gap between clients and developers.
* **Planning & Communication:** Excellent organisational skills to balance competing priorities, paired with clear, confident communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Ability to stay calm under pressure, respond effectively to critical incidents, and adapt to changing client priorities.
## **What Success Looks Like**
* **Trusted Partner Status:** Clients rely on you as a responsive and proactive extension of their team.
* **Operational Excellence:** Support requests are triaged and resolved within SLA targets, while releases are deployed without risk or surprises.
* **Reduced Support Demand:** You actively spot recurring issues and work with dev teams to implement permanent platform fixes.
* **Seamless Collaboration:** Delivery, QA, dev, and client teams work together smoothly under your direction.
## **Benefits & Perks**
**We believe that taking care of our team means offering real flexibility, great time off, and meaningful health and growth benefits. Here is what you can expect when you join LAB:**
* **Flexible Working Patterns:** Enjoy a 4-day work week option (compressed hours) along with full remote working (UK-based) and flexible core hours to suit your life.
* **Generous Time Off:**
+ 28 Days Annual Leave (excluding Bank Holidays).
+ Your Birthday Off every year.
+ 1 Paid Charity Day per year to support a cause close to your heart.
+ Christmas Slow-Down: Agency slowdown between Christmas and New Year so everyone can rest properly.

* **Learning & Development:** Clear growth paths and opportunities to get involved with collective initiatives like Aspiration Digital.
* **Work Anywhere policy**
* **Human-First Culture:** A supportive environment that respects boundaries, encourages honest feedback, and prioritises your mental health and work-life balance.

This is a rare hybrid role. You’ll be both the operator running a physical, logistically demanding channel and the model-builder (with a team to support) deciding who we mail and why. **Essential:**
* 7+ years across direct mail, CRM, lifecycle or performance marketing, with at least 2–3 years owning a channel or function end-to-end
* Hands-on with data: you personally build response/propensity models and write the SQL/Python to source, clean and join the data behind them
* Track record scaling a measurable acquisition or retention channel with real commercial impact (CAC, ROI, incremental LTV)
* Fluent in the economics: you size, forecast and defend a channel on unit economics and LTV, not volume
* Comfortable running the operational side: creative briefs, print/mail production, logistics and vendor management
* Strong grasp of targeting and measurement: segmentation, holdouts, incrementality testing, attribution
* A commercial communicator who can earn the trust of finance, data, product and engineering

* Experience in financial services, regulated or other consumer categories where offers and eligibility matter

* Experience building a channel or function from scratch

* Background hiring and developing an analytics or marketing team

* **Operator and analyst in one:** you can run the sends and build the model that decides them
* **Commercially driven:** you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not pieces mailed
* **A first-principles thinker:** you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

# Customer Service Executive - Collections
Nottingham, United Kingdom
At Liberis, our mission is to empower small and medium-sized businesses by removing finance as a friction to growth, delivering contextual, embedded financial solutions to support merchants at every stage of their business lifecycle.
**The team**
We are the Collections team! A dedicated group with a clear mission: to assist customers facing financial challenges and guide them back to good standing wherever possible. With team members based in the UK, Sweden, Germany and the US, we are looking for an enthusiastic Collections Agent to join our rapidly growing global Collections team and support Liberis' growth in the UK market!
**Who are you?**
As a Collections Agent, you'll take the helm in our in-house collection process, steering a diverse receivables book toward success. Your mission: to maintain impeccable standards of accuracy and timeliness, driving up collection rates while ensuring every customer enjoys a top-notch experience.
**Responsibilities**
* **Conducting daily monitoring** into our receivables book to uncover underperforming and inactive customers, using your sharp analytical skills to identify patterns and opportunities.
* **Solving puzzles:** diving deep in to the why behind customer inactivity, utilising a variety of resources to uncover the most efficient solutions for rehabilitating these customers
* **Direct engagement:** connecting directly with our customers through daily phone calls and emails, bringing energy and enthusiasm to every interactions as you work to reignite their engagement.
* **Legal liaison:** contacting customers we’ve been unable to reach via legal letters, to ensure our message is clear and our approach is effective.
* Take charge in ensuring that defaulting account volumes stay within budget limits by strategising and implementing tactics to minimise the need for accounts to be sent for Debt Collection.
* **Fairness Ambassador:** above all, you’ll champion our commitment to treating customers fairly, ensuring that every action you take reflects the Liberis behaviours and strengthens our customer relationships.
* Thrive in an environment that encourages independent decision-making and have the autonomy to manage and prioritise your daily workload, while always having the support of your team and line managers.
**We think you’ll need**
We're seeking a dynamic individual with a blend of skills and experiences that will make them an invaluable asset to our team:
* Demonstrated experience within a collections team, preferably in SME collections.
* A proven ability to self-manage and prioritise tasks effectively.
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills, enabling seamless interactions with individuals at all levels.
* High level of integrity in all actions and decisions.
* Proficiency in Excel.
* Keen attention to detail to ensure accuracy and precision in all tasks.
* Ability to identify and propose improvements to processes and procedures.
**What happens next?**
Think this sounds like the right next move for you? Or if you’re not completely confident that you fit our exact criteria, apply anyway and we can arrange a call to see if the role is fit for you. Humility is a wonderful thing, and we are interested in hearing about what you can add to Liberis!
**Our hybrid approach**
Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week, but ideally 4 days. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

# SENIOR SUSTAINABILITY CONSULTANT – MANCHESTER, EDINBURGH OR BRISTOL OFFICE
#### Manchester, Edinburgh, or Bristol
**Ready to take a leading role in delivering high-profile, design-led projects within a flexible, equitable and employee-owned business? At Max Fordham, you'll combine technical excellence with real influence, helping clients navigate complex sustainability challenges while shaping the future of our environmental assessment services.**
**We are looking for a Senior Sustainability Consultant to strengthen and grow our team, supporting project delivery, client relationships and service development. This role is ideally based in our Manchester, Edinburgh or Bristol office.**
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
Based in either our Manchester, Edinburgh or Bristol offices, you will manage a range of projects, with support from junior consultants, while working closely with our Certification Manager and other experienced colleagues to review and strengthen our technical standards, templates and delivery approach.
Most of the assessments you lead will be BREEAM, BREEAM International and WELL, with opportunities to work across BREEAM Domestic, Fitwel and BREEAM Infrastructure, as well as bespoke assessments against client-specific frameworks. You will also act as lead sustainability consultant on projects, coordinating sustainability input across different disciplines. From time to time, there will be opportunities to deliver complementary services that support certification, including sustainability strategies, planning advice and design team workshops on topics such as climate change adaptation, the Net Zero Carbon Building Standard and ESG. You will work closely with our wider sustainability specialists in materials, wellbeing, net zero carbon, building performance and strategic advice.
You will take responsibility for optimising the team’s technical delivery processes, developing opportunities to grow the service and, over time, helping to build the team. Supported by our Certification Manager, you will play an important role in supervising, mentoring, training and onboarding junior team members, helping to maintain a high standard of work across the group. We see this as a valuable role for someone who enjoys sharing experience, shaping good practice and contributing to team quality.
**ABOUT YOU**
You will bring confidence, sound judgement and substantial professional experience, providing trusted advice while taking a thoughtful and practical approach to improving how work is delivered.
You will have strong technical knowledge of environmental assessments, excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organisational ability, and a genuine commitment to delivering sustainable outcomes on your projects while contributing to the development of the wider group and practice.
You will enjoy building lasting relationships with clients, collaborators and colleagues, and will bring strong knowledge of sustainability assessment schemes.
You will have a strong understanding of how sustainable outcomes can be achieved across different project types, alongside a broad awareness of sustainability issues within the built environment. You will be able to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to identify the best approach for each project, while confidently advocating for sustainability within project teams.
**Essential experience:**
* At least 6 years of experience as a sustainability assessor in the built environment
* Qualified BREEAM Assessor experienced in positively guiding multiple building and assessment types through to delivery
* Experienced WELL AP
* Knowledge of other environmental assessment methods such as BREEAM Domestic Refurbishment, Fitwel, LEED, Living Building Challenge etc.
* Experience leading and coordinating sustainability advice on projects
* Experience of supervising others
* Experience of managing multiple projects
* Experience of the whole construction process
**Additional desirable experience:**
* Experience of managing project profitability
* Able to prepare bids and fee proposals
* Experience of workshop facilitation
* Chartered Environmentalist
* Qualified BREEAM Advisory Professional
* Qualified Fitwel Ambassador
* Qualified HQM Assessor
* Qualified LEED AP
* Knowledge of UK Net Zero Carbon Building Standard
* Setting and delivering sustainability strategies for new projects or portfolios
* Experience in Life Cycle Carbon Analysis
* Experience in developing Circular Economy Strategies
* Experience of developing bespoke sustainability frameworks
**WHY JOIN US?**
At Max Fordham we are working with the built environment to deliver a sustainable future and a thriving planet. Our UK’s leading, award-winning MEP engineering practice is owned by the people who work here and committed to leading the industry in tackling the challenges posed by the climate and biodiversity crises.
Shared responsibility to look after each other, to care for our communities, and to create a sustainable world is our embedded belief and we pride ourselves on providing an open, inclusive and supportive environment for our employees and partners.
**WHAT WE OFFER**
* Excellent growth opportunities for your personal and career development in a knowledge driven environment
* Mentored support towards professional accreditation
* An annual professional institution subscription
* Interesting and technically challenging projects
* An inclusive culture and cooperative environment
* Opportunities for involvement in business-running activities
* Flexible working arrangements
* Competitive pay and employee bonus
* Future opportunities for Partnership
* Six weeks holiday (including Bank holidays)
* Max Fordham Pension Scheme
* Other benefits include generous paid parental leave, sick pay, and treatment pay.

If you are interested in working with us, we are keen to hear from you. # GRADUATE SUSTAINABILITY CONSULTANT – CAMBRIDGE
#### Cambridge
**Help shape the transition to a net zero built environment. As a Graduate Sustainability Consultant at Max Fordham, you'll work alongside experienced specialists to deliver client-facing advice on BREEAM, embodied carbon, circular economy strategies, and industry-leading sustainability standards, including the UK Net Zero Carbon Buildings Standard. From your first day, you'll contribute to projects that influence the environmental performance of buildings and support our vision of a beautifully engineered, net zero carbon world.**
**This position is available for an immediate start. If you are interested in working with us, alongside your CV, please provide a conversational cover letter within the application form, that tells us how your skills match the role criteria, and your interests align with our vision of a beautifully engineered net zero carbon world for a sustainable future. We are keen to hear from you.**
### ABOUT MAX FORDHAM
Here, sustainability is not just a guiding fundament but an everyday practice, woven into the fabric of our projects and professional culture. As you expand your expertise, you’ll play a vital role in delivering technical solutions that advance both environmental responsibility and engineering quality, ensuring every project meaningfully contributes to the legacy of the built environment. Max Fordham is an award-winning MEP engineering practice that is owned by the people who work here, and we are all committed to leading the industry in tackling the challenges posed by the climate and biodiversity crises. We believe it is a shared responsibility to look after each other, care for our communities, and create a sustainable world. We pride ourselves on providing an open, inclusive and supportive environment for our employees and partners.
### ABOUT THE ROLE
Graduate Sustainability Consultants are part of our Sustainability group with a particular focus on BREEAM, embodied carbon and circular economy. Based in our Cambridge office, you will work collaboratively with colleagues across all five offices and with our building services engineers to help clients set, test and deliver ambitious sustainability outcomes. You would be working in a purpose-led, employee-owned practice working on projects across multiple sectors, from early strategy and brief-setting through to design, construction and completion.
You will have the chance to build specialist knowledge in environmental assessment and carbon reduction while contributing to wider strategic sustainability advice (UKNZCBS, early-stage brief-setting). You will start by specialising in supporting environmental and wellbeing (BREEAM and WELL) assessments, contribute to embodied carbon modelling and reporting, and explore circular economy opportunities that reduce waste and improve resource efficiency. You will learn how to shape client ambitions and project decision-making through providing pro-active advice.
From the start, you will be in a client facing role, be encouraged to combine analytical thinking, clear communication and curiosity. You will also work with architects, engineers and contractors to turn sustainability targets into practical actions, helping to coordinate evidence, prepare reports, review design information and challenge approaches where they may lead to poor environmental outcomes.
As your experience grows you will have opportunities to learn broader services within our Sustainability group such as:
* BREEAM strategy, assessment management and evidence coordination
* Embodied carbon and whole life carbon modelling, reporting and reduction advice
* Circular economy strategies, resource efficiency and design for adaptability, reuse and recovery
* UK Net Zero Carbon Buildings Standard
* Sustainability strategies for buildings, estates and masterplans
* Scope 3 assessments
* Building performance, energy benchmarking and climate resilience advice
* Health, wellbeing and wider social and environmental outcomes
The successful candidates will gain experience across the breadth of our sustainability consultancy work while developing a clear technical pathway. You will be supported to understand how standards, planning requirements, client briefs and design decisions interact, and how sustainability advice can influence projects at both strategic and detailed levels. You may also contribute to internal sustainability initiatives across the practice and support our building services engineers to deliver better outcomes on their projects.
You will be supported to work towards chartership as a Chartered Environmentalist or Chartered Engineer within four years of joining the practice. You will receive mentoring, structured development and exposure to a wide range of live project work, helping you build both technical confidence and consultancy skills in an industry-leading practice.
### ABOUT YOU
We are looking for motivated, curious and enthusiastic graduates who want to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable built environment. You should have some knowledge of construction through study or previous experience. You will enjoy working with evidence, data and design information, and be able to communicate clearly with colleagues, clients and wider project teams.
You should ideally have a degree in engineering, architecture or another that is construction related (minimum 2:1 or equivalent).
You will have an analytical mind, excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organisational ability and a flexible approach. You will be comfortable learning new technical topics, asking good questions and working across a broad range of projects. Attention to detail will be important, particularly when preparing assessment evidence, carbon reports and client-facing advice.
### WHAT WE OFFER
Max Fordham is a unique working environment valuing diverse thinkers, with all our members sharing a commitment to a sustainable future and a passion for the built environment and good design. Our employee-owned structure puts equity at the heart of the business, creating a highly transparent and collaborative practice structure where everyone has a chance to be heard. We offer:
* Excellent growth opportunities for your personal and career development in a knowledge driven environment
* Interesting and technically challenging projects
* An inclusive culture and cooperative environment
* Competitive pay and employee bonus
* Mentored support towards professional accreditation
* An annual professional institution subscription
* Opportunities for involvement in business-running activities
* Flexible working arrangements
* Six weeks holiday (including Bank holidays)
* Max Fordham Pension Scheme
* Other benefits include generous paid parental leave, sick pay, and treatment pay, Employee Assistance Programme
* Future opportunities for Partnership
**CLOSING DATE:**11th August 2026 at 22:00 (GMT)
**HOW TO APPLY**

**Distributor Sales Manager**
**Location: Newcastle upon Tyne, open to other areas of the country with occasional travel to HQ**

As the Distributor Sales Manager (DSM), you will be responsible for the development and growth of the tommee tippee brand in a selection of markets through our Distributor partners in the various trade channels ranging from Baby Specialist retailers, Mass market, Digital, on all product categories.
You will manage distributor relationships through the establishment of Joint Business Plans and annual negotiations to deliver agreed sales targets. You will be a credible partner to the chosen retailers/distributors and provide the relevant insights and thought leadership to grow the market share of tommee tippee.
You will also gather market information and complete market initiatives updates, forecasting and reporting on a monthly and quarterly basis for your markets, as well as conducting specific market analysis.
The role includes travel to our distributor offices.
**What you will be doing:**
The DSM is responsible for a broad range of tasks from day-to-day sales activities including forecasting and account administration, to hands on account management and development of assigned distributors. This will include, but may not be limited to:
* Develop, execute and manage the sales plan with existing and future distributors
* Complete Joint Business Plans that deliver incremental sales and contribution
* Improve distributor sales, margin and contribution
* Deliver forecasts, orders, and payments and work with customer service, demand planning and logistics team to execute the plans in line with the S&OP process.
* Recommend the pricing adaptation per market on a yearly basis based on market and competition
* Collaborate with marketing teams to implement the right marketing toolkits with Distributors to execute the brand strategy in line with Group guidelines.
* Negotiate specific trading terms, promotional strategies, and other activity in line with the strategy
* Increase listings, distribution, and visibility of tommee tippee brand
* Track and monitor the compliance and impact of promotional plans, recommending corrective actions where necessary
* Interrogate shopper, retailer, and competitor insights in the region, to identify barriers to consumption and opportunities for category growth.
* Management of “best in class” execution of all New Product Developments
* Share best practices proactively across markets and learnings from other regions
* Sell out / Stock/ sell in /trend analysis
* SKU level forecasting and SKU level margin analysis
* Competitor pricing analysis
* Management of budget
* Ensure reporting deadlines are met
* Manage KPIs (stock levels, forecast accuracy, commercial performance)

5+ years’ experience in talent acquisition or recruitment operations, with a strong understanding of end-to-end processes in high-volume or multi-role environments.

## Senior Electrochemical Stack Engineer
****About Mission Zero Technologies****
****We’re a London-based climate tech startup working to reinvent carbon for a thriving planet. Since 2020, we have rapidly pioneered the world’s most versatile direct air capture (DAC) technology to recover historic CO2 emissions from the atmosphere, anywhere at any scale. Backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, the XPRIZE foundation, Stripe, and the UK Government, we’ve moved a brand new climate technology from lab to commercial plants in under three years to rapidly empower carbon removal and sustainable utilisation.****
## About the role
Join MZT at a pivotal moment as we transition from an early-stage R&D startup to a revenue-generating company ready to scale our direct-air capture technology globally.
We're looking for an Electrochemical Stack Engineer to develop our next generation of stack designs. Electrodialytic approaches to DAC lean on established electrodialysis designs, however these designs are far from optimal for the specificity of electrochemical direct-air capture. As our Electrochemical Stack Engineer you'll lead stack development at MZT. You'll define the opportunity areas for our next-generation stack, develop concepts that attack the biggest resistance losses in the cell, while ensuring stability and robustness, and lead the build–test–evaluate cycles that prove (or kill) them. For winning concepts, you'll scale them into full-size stacks, navigating supply chain and manufacturing constraints along the way.
The role has two sides. You'll lead on the stacks we procure, assessing what the supply chain offers, judging their suitability for our process and specifying modifications where needed. In parallel, you'll lead the development of DAC-optimised electrodialytic stacks designed around our process conditions from the start. On both fronts you'll work closely with our process, mechanical and electrical engineers so that the stack meets the requirements of our DAC technology and the wider plant design.
Reporting to the R&D leadership team, you'll work alongside key members of the R&D lab, and mentor junior scientists and engineers as the team grows.
## What you’ll be doing
* Defining the opportunity areas for MZT's next-generation electrochemical stack: quantifying where the losses sit and which are worth attacking first
* Developing concepts for performance improvement across cell geometry, materials and flow design, backed by models and analysis that clarify your predictions
* Leading build–test–evaluate cycles with the R&D team: designing testing campaigns, characterising stack performance and tracing observed phenomena back to underlying mechanisms and design features
* Scaling successful concepts into full-scale stacks, working through fabrication, assembly and design-for-manufacture constraints
* Leading stack procurement: assessing commercially available stacks, specifying modifications and managing technical relationships with vendors and manufacturers
* Articulating stack requirements to process, mechanical, electrical and safety engineers so the stack and the wider plant design converge
* Closing the feedback loop: internalising learnings from every campaign and applying them to subsequent stack designs
* Mentoring, guiding and supporting junior staff, helping them acquire new skills, knowledge and capabilities
## What you’ll need to be successful in this role
* A deep grounding in the theory and mathematical principles that describe electrochemical processes. You understand electrochemistry from first principles, not just by analogy or heuristics
* Experience designing electrochemical stacks at multiple scales involving aqueous electrolytes, ion-exchange membranes and gas generation
* A strong grasp of how the culmination of geometric features, material selection and process parameters determines the critical performance parameters of a stack
* A track record of taking designs through to fabricated, assembled hardware in collaboration with mechanical, electrical and process engineers
* Significant experience designing and executing testing campaigns, with the diagnostic instinct to trace behaviour back to root mechanisms
* The habit of reducing problems to first principles and building models to sharpen your thinking, paired with the judgement to reach for heuristics when they're the better tool
* Equal appetite for ideation and execution: you can get obsessed with a problem, and you finish what you start
* As comfortable in the lab or workshop as you are developing designs, models and analysis
* Experience mentoring, guiding or supervising junior colleagues
* A degree in chemical engineering, electrochemical engineering, materials science or a related discipline
* Roughly 5–10 years' experience spanning stack design, testing and scale-up
* Clear communication skills across engineering disciplines
## Ideally, you’ll also have:
* Direct experience with electrodialysis, bipolar membranes or related ion-exchange membrane processes
* Hands-on experience with carbonate or alkaline electrolytes, and with managing gas evolution and two-phase flow inside cells
* Electrochemical or multiphysics modelling experience (COMSOL or equivalent, or your own codes)
* Experience with EIS and other advanced electrochemical diagnostics
* Working CAD skills, enough to take your own concepts from sketch to drawing
* Experience working directly with stack, membrane or component manufacturers, and navigating their manufacturing constraints
* A PhD in electrochemistry, electrochemical engineering or a related field
* Experience in a startup or similarly fast-moving R&D environment
* Patents or publications in electrochemical cell or stack design
* Most importantly, we'd also welcome hearing from you even if you feel you are under or overqualified - as finding the right person is critical.
****What we can offer you****

* Access to wellness and medical cover

At Formula 1, we are passionate about delivering the world’s greatest sports and entertainment spectacle leaving a positive legacy wherever we race. A technically strong, calm under pressure engineer who thrives in a live broadcast environment and is committed to delivering highly reliable services during the most demanding operational windows of the F1 season.

*Prior to the role it would be essential that you:*
* Have experience working in a broadcast, media, or telecommunications environment.
* Ideally have experience within Live Sports or similarly high-pressure operational contexts.

* Experience working directly with high availability distribution or transmission systems.
* Familiarity with troubleshooting real time broadcast chain issues across multiple vendors, technologies and signal types.
* Previous experience supporting projects involving system upgrades or infrastructure modernisation.

* In-depth knowledge of television distribution systems, platforms and standards.

* Understanding of MPEG2 Transport Streams and TR101290 analysis.

* transport stream workflows.

* Certifications related to broadcast engineering, IT networking, or media transport (e.g., SMPTE, Cisco, or equivalent).

* Calm and composed when working under pressure.
* Methodical, detail oriented and proactive in identifying potential issues before they impact service.
* Adaptable, with the ability to switch focus quickly during live operational environments.
* A clear communicator who builds trust with colleagues and external partners.

## Operational Services Manager – NHS Sponsorship Available
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced **Operational Services Manager** to join the **Neurology Division at The Walton Centre NHS Foundation Trust in Liverpool**.
The successful candidate will join the Neurology Divisional Senior Team and report to the **Clinical Business Manager**. The role is focused on the day-to-day operational management of neurological services, service improvement, performance management and supporting high-quality patient care.
## About the Role
The Operational Services Manager will provide operational leadership across the Neurology service and help ensure that clinical and non-clinical services meet agreed performance, quality and operational standards.
### Key Responsibilities
Your responsibilities will include:
* Managing the day-to-day operations of the Neurology service.
* Providing operational leadership across specialist services.
* Supporting pathway development and service improvement initiatives.
* Monitoring data quality, KPIs and operational performance.
* Ensuring waiting-time targets and contracted activity levels are achieved.
* Supporting activity planning and capacity-and-demand modelling.
* Identifying service risks, improvement opportunities and potential hazards.
* Supporting the delivery of Cost Improvement Plans (CIP).
* Managing budgets and financial responsibilities within designated areas.
* Supporting divisional transformation projects.
* Working with senior managers to improve the quality and efficiency of patient services.
* Providing effective leadership during challenging operational situations.
## About The Walton Centre
**The Walton Centre NHS Foundation Trust** is a specialist NHS organisation providing treatment and care in **neurology, neurosurgery, spinal and pain management**.
Based in Fazakerley, Liverpool, the Trust provides specialist services to patients across the UK and beyond.
The organisation employs approximately **1,450 staff** and provides care to around **127,000 outpatients and 18,000 inpatients each year**.
The Trust is recognised for its focus on patient care, staff development and specialist neuroscience services.
## Person Specification
### Essential Qualifications
Applicants should have:
* A degree or equivalent level of experience.
* Relevant management or leadership training or qualification.
* Evidence of recent continuing professional development (CPD).
### Desirable
* IHRIM qualification or equivalent relevant experience.
## Essential Knowledge and Experience
The successful candidate should demonstrate:
* Experience working in a healthcare environment in a management or supervisory role.
* Strong knowledge of NHS targets and key performance indicators.
* Understanding of NHS national guidance and governance requirements.
* Knowledge of risk management, complaints procedures and NHS governance processes.
* Understanding of NHS and Trust priorities and objectives.
* Knowledge of information governance, GDPR and data-quality requirements.
* Experience in service planning and organisation.
* Experience in service development or change management.
* Experience preparing reports and business cases.
* Experience developing policies and procedures.
* Experience managing staff and maintaining effective employee relationships.
* Experience working with different staff groups.
* Understanding of HR processes, including recruitment, appraisal and performance management.
* Experience with timesheets or related workforce systems.
* Experience analysing budgets and developing Cost Improvement Plans (CIP).
### Desirable Experience
* Project management experience.
## Skills and Personal Attributes
The ideal candidate should have:
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* The ability to handle sensitive complaints and challenging situations professionally.
* Strong time-management and organisational skills.
* The ability to prioritise competing demands and meet deadlines.
* Excellent presentation and influencing skills.
* Strong negotiation and motivational abilities.
* The ability to build effective working relationships across different professional groups.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary teams.
* Effective team leadership and staff motivation skills.
* The ability to assess complex performance and contractual information.
* A practical and creative approach to problem solving.
* The ability to work independently and make evidence-based decisions.
* The ability to remain effective under pressure.
* Good IT skills.
* The ability to work across different sites when required.

## Summary
\*\*\*INTERNAL AND PARTNER APPLICANTS ONLY PLEASE\*\*\* Applications will only be considered from current employees of the National Trust, National Lottery Heritage Fund, and Natural England.
We're looking for an Advocacy Manager to lead the development and delivery of advocacy activity across the Nature Towns and Cities coalition.
**About the role profile**: This role is being recruited using the National Trust's External Affairs Consultant (Grade 5) role profile and will be known internally by this title. While the profile reflects the broad skills, knowledge and experience required, the responsibilities and focus of this post are most accurately described in this advert.
**If you would like to discuss this role please contact info@naturetownsandcities.org.uk**
## What it's like to work here
This is a high-profile role that will build understanding, awareness and support for the Nature Towns and Cities mission among political decision-makers and key stakeholders across the UK. Working across a unique coalition of partners, you'll help ensure the benefits of urban nature are understood by politicians, policy-makers and sector leaders, while strengthening relationships that support delivery of the programme.
Nature Towns and Cities is working to put nature and green space at the heart of towns, cities and neighbourhoods across the UK. Through this role, you'll help build the partnerships, visibility and political support needed to enable long-term action and investment in urban nature.
## What you'll be doing
You'll lead the delivery of the Nature Towns and Cities advocacy strategy, building awareness, understanding and support for the programme among political audiences and stakeholders across Westminster, Holyrood, Cardiff Bay and Stormont. This includes helping decision-makers understand the scale of unequal access to nature and the role Nature Towns and Cities can play in addressing it.
A confident relationship-builder, you'll develop and maintain networks with parliamentarians, government officials, local government leaders, metro mayors, city and regional partners, sector organisations and other influential stakeholders across all four nations who can champion the programme and its goals.
Working across the coalition will be your natural mode. You'll collaborate with colleagues from Natural England, the National Lottery Heritage Fund, the National Trust and a growing range of partners across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland to identify opportunities and tailor engagement approaches to different political and policy contexts while maintaining a coherent UK-wide narrative.
You'll help tell the story of Nature Towns and Cities by developing briefings, presentations and stakeholder engagement materials that demonstrate the impact of the programme and showcase action taking place in towns and cities across the UK.
You'll monitor political and policy developments across all four nations, identifying opportunities for engagement and providing insight to programme partners. While the role does not undertake party-political activity or lobbying on behalf of individual organisations, it plays an important role in building understanding of the programme, sharing evidence, convening stakeholders and fostering constructive relationships with decision-makers across the UK.
You'll also coordinate advocacy activity across partners, ensuring learning, intelligence and opportunities are shared effectively and helping to build a strong network of supporters and champions for Nature Towns and Cities.
For line management purposes, this role will sit within the National Trust's Communications and Advocacy Department and report to the Head of Public Affairs. The successful candidate will work on behalf of the Nature Towns and Cities programme, with accountability to the Nature Towns and Cities Portfolio Board and the Public Affairs leads of the National Trust, Natural England and The National Lottery Heritage Fund. The role will lead and deliver an agreed advocacy strategy.
## Who we're looking for
We welcome applications from people with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. We're particularly interested in hearing from applicants who have experience of political engagement, stakeholder management, partnership working and building support for complex programmes or initiatives.
You'll bring:
* Experience of delivering advocacy, public affairs, stakeholder engagement or external affairs activity.
* Strong understanding of political institutions, policy-making processes and stakeholder landscapes across the UK, including experience of working within devolved policy and political environments.
* Experience of building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.
* Excellent communication skills, including developing briefings, presentations and stakeholder engagement materials.
* Experience of working across organisational boundaries and managing multiple stakeholder interests.
* Strong project management and coordination skills.
* An ability to identify opportunities, build consensus and bring partners together around shared objectives.
* A proactive, collaborative and politically aware approach.
* A commitment to inclusive and equitable ways of working.
## The package
The National Trust has the motto ‘For everyone, for ever’ at its heart. We’re working hard to create an inclusive culture, where everyone feels they belong. It’s important that our people reflect and represent the diversity of the communities and audiences we serve. We welcome and value difference, so when we say we’re for everyone, we want everyone to be welcome in our teams too.

If you enjoy creating experiences that inspire people, tell powerful stories and help communities feel connected to important places, we’d love to hear from you.
We’re looking for a creative, audience led and commercially focused Experience and Programming Manager to shape how people visit and experience Heartlands and East Pool Mine. This is a rare opportunity to develop programmes, interpretation, partnerships and content that connect people with heritage, place and community, while helping us stay relevant to everyday audiences, encourage new visitors and support a flourishing future for the sites.
You’ll bring together storytelling, participation, audience insight, marketing and partnership working to create inclusive, engaging and memorable experiences. Just as importantly, you’ll think about how great programming can grow audiences, open up creative income opportunities and help Heartlands and East Pool Mine become vibrant, sustainable places that bring heritage and culture closer to communities.
**Contract:** Fixed term, 2 years
**Hours:** Full time, 37.5 hours per week
**Working pattern:** 7.5 hours a day, 5 days a week. Flexible weekend and bank holiday working may be required as the operation moves towards a 7 day offer.
**Salary:** Circa £31k
**Interview date:** Tuesday 25 August 2026
## What it's like to work here
This role is based in Pool, Cornwall, working across two sites, Heartlands and East Pool Mine.
Heartlands is an eight hectare site at the heart of Cornwall’s mining heritage, bringing together historic buildings, green spaces and community facilities. Nearby, East Pool Mine cares for nationally important mining heritage within a World Heritage landscape.
The National Trust and our partner, Cornwall Rural Community Charity, are in negotiations to secure the lease for Heartlands with Cornwall Council. Together, we want to work with the local community to transform Heartlands into a vibrant place for opportunity, inclusion and experiences.
You’ll be joining a supportive and collaborative team where people, places and stories are at the heart of everything we do. This is a busy and evolving environment, used by visitors, the community, neighbours, partners, volunteers, tenants and colleagues, with huge potential to test new ideas and create experiences that feel meaningful, repeatable and sustainable.
## What you'll be doing
You’ll lead the development and delivery of experiences, interpretation and programmes that help people connect with Heartlands and East Pool Mine. This could include events, activities, creative programmes, community led experiences, interpretation, digital content and campaigns that bring the sites to life in fresh and engaging ways.
You’ll use audience insight, visitor feedback and data to understand who already visits, who returns, who is not yet engaging, and how our offer can become more relevant, welcoming and accessible.
A key part of the role will be thinking creatively and commercially about programming. You’ll identify opportunities to generate income through events, partnerships, participation, hire, paid for experiences, repeatable programme models or other activity linked to the sites’ purpose and potential.
You will turn programmes, partnerships and stories into compelling content and campaigns. Helping the right audiences find and understand what’s on offer, you’ll support audience growth, repeat visits and help define the identity of Heartlands and East Pool Mine.
Partnership working will be central to the role. You’ll work with colleagues, communities, volunteers, creative practitioners, tenants, local organisations and external stakeholders to create activity rooted in place and shaped with people. You’ll also look for partnerships that bring shared value, whether through community benefit, joint programming, audience reach, skills, funding or earned income.
You’ll manage budgets, plans and resources carefully, making sure activity is well organised, safe, deliverable and evaluated. You’ll also lead and support others, helping the team and volunteers develop the confidence, skills and shared purpose needed to deliver memorable experiences that support both public benefit and sustainable growth.

## Role Overview
In this role, you'll help shape and establish a brand-new Business Management function within Nest's Services and Solutions (SaS) directorate. Working at the heart of a newly formed team, you'll play a key role in helping the directorate plan, prioritise, report and operate effectively, providing the insight, coordination and structure that enables senior leaders to make informed decisions and deliver. Day-to-day, you'll support coordinating business planning, budgeting, resource management, performance reporting, governance activities and communications, ensuring the leadership team has timely and accurate insights to support decision making and that SaS operates smoothly and consistently. You'll build strong relationships across SaS and the wider organisation, bringing together information, tracking progress and helping to turn strategic priorities into practical outcomes.
Unlike many business management roles, this is not about maintaining established processes. You'll have the opportunity to help design and embed new ways of working, influence how the function develops and contribute to building a strong "one team" culture across SaS. As the function develops, you'll gain the opportunity to broaden your skills and develop towards deputising for the Business Manager in selected forums and activities.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable with ambiguity, and thrives on solving problems, creating order, building relationships and making things happen. If you're naturally proactive, curious and motivated by the opportunity to help build something new, this is a chance to have a real impact from day one.
****The minimum criteria for this role are:****
* Ability to solve problems
* Strong communication skills, able to work with a range of stakeholders and confident to contribute views and influence senior stakeholders (SaS Leadership level)
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail
* Proactive and reliable, with a pragmatic ‘gets it done’ mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high-quality and accurate outputs and delivering to deadlines
* Collaborative and team-oriented approach, able to build a network of relationships to support delivery
Don't worry if you think you don't have all the key skills, it might be worth taking the few minutes to apply as we're good at spotting potential. At Nest, you’ll have access to a range of learning opportunities to learn, grow and build the skills you need to be successful in your role and career.
**Please download a full job description to find a full scope, deliverables, experience and personal****attributes****required for this role.**

Everyone's personal situation is different.

* hybrid of office (Canary Wharf, London) and home working (there will be an expectation to attend the office, once - twice a week, or more, as required)
* reduce or vary working hours
* reduce or vary the days worked
* work compressed hours
* job share
Click here to see the benefits we offer at Nest.

## Directorate/Department Overview
Services and Solutions (SaS) is a newly formed directorate that brings together Nest's operational delivery, technology, data and change capabilities to deliver reliable, member focused services at scale. SaS has accountability for the delivery of Nest's member services through our strategic partners, managing the supplier relationship, monitoring performance and driving continuous improvement to provide a reliable cost-effective member service.
Alongside member service delivery, SaS provides enterprise-wide services across technology, data and change, delivering the platforms, services and change management activity that support Nest's long-term strategy. Working closely with internal teams and external partners, the directorate focuses on operational excellence, resilience, innovation and continuous improvement, ensuring services remain compliant, efficient and secure for good member outcomes.
## Organisational Overview
Nest is an award-winning workplace pension scheme, the largest in the country. Set up by the government to give every worker in the UK somewhere to save, our first-class responsible investment practice and governance are the backbone of what we do, supported by all the functions you’d expect to find in a thriving business. We’re committed to creating a workplace where you can be your authentic self and offer an inclusive and flexible working environment.

As a Utilities Planner, you will be the key contact before works for the operational team. You will have full accountability for the planning aspects of all works before they commence on site with some Streetworks involvement. You will ensure that all operational teams are able to undertake their work in line with the received push plans and requested dates as well as compliant with NRSWA and ensure that KPI timescales are adhered to minimising any financial impact to the company.

**Project Planning and Scheduling**
* Take ownership of the workstreams, coordinating the work from receipt, through to job completion.
* Schedule work orders in accordance with SLA’s, whilst optimising travel routes and increasing productivity.
* Identify noticing issues and apply early intervention, to ensure that all information derived from inspections and other sources is correctly handled to ensure correct response from utilities and other promoters of Street Works activity.
* Ensure that all the client and operational requirements are met in a professional and efficient manner.
* Provide daily and weekly reports as required and to ensure that all service levels and objectives are achieved.
* Provide a positive and innovative input into the team, through provision of solutions to problems and embracing change.
* Communicate project plans, status updates, and potential issues to all stakeholders, including team members, management, and clients.
* Participate in weekly operational planning meetings, daily operational PvA meetings, complete planning actions accordingly.

* Perform risk management to minimise project risks.
* Prepare and present regular progress reports, updates, and project health metrics to stakeholders.
* Ensure that safety issues are reported in line with Company procedures.
**Documentation and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all safety, regulatory, and industry standards within the utilities sector.
* Maintain up-to-date project files and documentation.
* Maintain timely and accurate input and uploading of information into the works management systems, ensuring that all issues are recorded and escalated.

* Experience in a planning / coordinator role.

* Ability to prioritise workload, multi-task and work under tight time pressures.
* Excellent communication skills.

* Logical mind.

Pretzl is redefining what a B2B marketing agency can be. As a B2B Technology-and-People-as-a-Service (TaPaaS) agency with approx. 350 people globally, we're not just advising clients - we're building the technology that transforms how businesses connect with their buyers.
Our flagship product, Journey Lab is changing the game for buyer journey optimisation. We need engineers who care deeply about the problems we're solving, not just the tickets they're assigned.
**Role overview**
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Engineer to join our Journey Lab squad and help us strengthen how the product is shaped, built, and operated.
We are hiring towards the upper end of Senior Engineer level. We’re looking for someone who has already been owning complex and ambiguous work, influencing technical direction, developing other engineers, and improving how a product team delivers.
You’ll be a senior technical contributor within a tight-knit team of four developers, one designer, and one product owner. You’ll own complex initiatives end-to-end, help break larger product opportunities into coherent vertical slices, contribute to the architectural direction of the platform, mentor other engineers, and raise the standard for how we plan, build, review, and ship work.
This isn’t a role for someone who wants to be handed fully specified tickets and churn out code. We need an engineer who wants to be involved earlier in the product process, working alongside product and design while problems are still being clarified, trade-offs are being discussed, and the right solution is still emerging.
We already have strong leadership buy-in for a more product-led engineering model. The opportunity here is to help embed that model day to day: bringing engineering judgement into shaping, improving delivery quality, and helping the wider team move away from a ticket-taking mindset towards shared ownership of product outcomes.
Exceptional candidates who demonstrate sustained Staff-level scope and impact may be considered for appointment at Staff Engineer level.
This is a fully remote, UK-based role with the expectation to travel to London approximately once per month. We are not currently hiring this role as an overseas remote position.
**As a Senior Engineer at Pretzl, you will:**
* Lead complex product work from early shaping through to production deployment
* Turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical approaches, sensible delivery plans, and coherent vertical slices
* Work directly with product leadership, design, and your squad to shape solutions that meet user needs
* Bring engineering judgement into conversations before work is fully specified, helping clarify gaps, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs
* Make pragmatic architectural decisions within your domain and clearly explain the reasoning behind them
* Design and build solutions that are maintainable, testable, and appropriately scalable
* Own delivery quality as well as implementation, ensuring work is meaningfully tested and production-ready
* Lead debugging efforts for complex issues and identify systemic problems, not just symptoms
* Create clear technical plans and pull requests that explain the reasoning behind the implementation, not just the code changes
* Mentor and develop other engineers through pairing, code reviews, feedback, and stretch opportunities
* Help improve engineering practices, product judgement, technical standards, and delivery effectiveness across the team
* Use AI development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code thoughtfully, treating them as collaborators rather than shortcuts that bypass understanding
* Communicate technical concepts, uncertainty, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Contribute to hiring and onboarding activities
**What We're Looking For:**
We’re looking for someone who combines strong engineering judgement with genuine product curiosity.
You do not need to be a product manager, but you should care about why something matters, how users will experience it, and whether the solution being shaped is the right one.
**Essential**:
* A sustained track record of operating effectively at Senior Engineer level
* Proven ability to lead complex and ambiguous product work from early shaping through to production
* Strong technical judgement, including pragmatic architectural decisions, clear trade-offs, and sensible management of technical debt
* Strong experience with modern web technologies; our stack includes SvelteKit, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker
* Genuine product curiosity, with the ability to challenge, clarify, and shape work constructively alongside product and design
* Evidence of impact beyond your own code, including mentoring engineers and improving team practices, quality, or delivery
* Excellent communication skills across both technical and non-technical audiences
* Confident use of AI development tools, such as Cursor or Claude Code, while maintaining understanding, ownership, and code quality
The level of appointment will reflect the scope and impact demonstrated through the interview process.
**Nice to Have:**
* Experience in B2B marketing or related domains
* Previous experience working in a product-led engineering team
* Experience with SvelteKit or a comparable modern frontend framework
* Experience operating systems on AWS and Kubernetes
**This Role May Not Be for You If:**
* You are looking for your first opportunity at Senior Engineer level
* You prefer to pick up fully specified tickets rather than contribute to shaping the work
* You expect product and design decisions to be fully resolved before engineering becomes involved
* You use AI tools to generate code you cannot explain, test, or maintain
* You want technical leadership to be primarily about authority rather than ownership, influence, and developing others
**Our Tech Stack:**
* Frontend: SvelteKit, TypeScript
* Backend: Node.js, TypeScript
* Database: PostgreSQL
* Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker
* AI development tools: Cursor, Claude Code, and related tools where they add genuine value
We do not expect candidates to have worked with every element of the stack. Strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgement, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies matter more than exact keyword matches.
**And in return, Pretzl offers:**
* Competitive compensation package
* 25 days leave, increasing to 30 days based on service
* Additional 'moments that matter days' for birthdays, sports days, and other important life moments
* Time off for volunteering
* Life assurance, healthcare cashplan, employee assistance programme, and Digital GP
* Cycle to work scheme
* Flexible spending allowance for health/dental insurance, wellbeing, family life, work life, hobbies and experiences
* Quarterly in-person and virtual social activities
* Office transfer and secondment opportunities
**Why us?**
**Sustainable Pace, Real Balance** We believe great work happens when people have space to live their lives. No crunch culture, no expectation to be always-on. We trust you to do excellent work within reasonable hours. We have offices across the UK with a hybrid working policy, and are open to remote applicants if you’re not located close to an office.
**We're Not a Feature Factory**
We are building a product-led engineering culture where engineers are involved in the work before it becomes a list of tickets. You’ll work collaboratively from feedback capture through definition, solution shaping, build, review, and release. Your input will matter at every stage, and you’ll help the team continue moving towards shared ownership of product outcomes.
**Clear Career Progression**
We have a career framework with a clear path for those who want to deepen technical leadership, or a shift into management if that is your thing. We review progress against this roadmap regularly and encoruage the development and growth of our people.

Almost every part of our lives is now online: we use online spaces to learn, play, make connections, do business and keep in touch. This role will be part of Ofcom’s Online Safety Group, whose broader purpose is to lead our work in ensuring UK citizens have a safer life online. The Online Safety Technology team conducts research to build knowledge and understanding in subject areas fundamental to online safety. ---
Role Purpose
The Construction Manager will play a key role within Omexom's TOHL Scotland business unit, managing the on-site delivery of transmission overhead line (OHL) projects for SSEN Transmission across Scotland. Working closely with the Project Manager and site delivery teams, the postholder will be responsible for the day-to-day technical and operational coordination of OHL new build, refurbishment, and maintenance schemes, spanning access, foundations, steelwork, and stringing activities.
This is a site-based role requiring regular travel across Scotland, including to remote and upland locations. The Construction Manager will be expected to take a proactive, hands-on approach to programme and resource management, technical problem-solving, and client interface, whilst maintaining Omexom's standards for safety, quality, and commercial performance throughout the project lifecycle and offering support and guidance to the project engineers, site engineers and project support staff.
---
Key Responsibilities
Technical Delivery & Site Management
• Oversee and coordinate site construction activities across all OHL work packages — including access track construction, foundation installation, steelwork erection, conductor stringing, and associated civil works — ensuring works are delivered safely, on programme, and to the required quality standard.
• Act as the primary technical reference on site, providing engineering support and guidance to engineers, site supervisors, gangs, and subcontractors to resolve construction issues and maintain delivery momentum.
• Review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and design documentation issued by Omexom's design engineers, identifying conflicts or constructability issues and facilitating resolution with the design team in a timely manner.
• Coordinate the inspection, acceptance, and handover of completed works in accordance with Omexom and SSEN Transmission quality requirements.
• Monitor and enforce compliance with all relevant technical standards, including those specified under SSEN Transmission's project-specific technical schedules and Omexom's Engineering Management Plan.
Programme, Resource & Logistics Management
• Assist the Project Manager in developing and maintaining the project programme, including short-term look-ahead schedules, resource histograms, and activity-level sequencing plans.
• Coordinate site resources — subcontractors, labour, plant, materials, and equipment — across multiple concurrent work fronts, ensuring the right resources are mobilised to the right location at the right time.
• Manage the procurement and logistics of materials and equipment in conjunction with the supply chain team, tracking deliveries and managing site storage to minimise programme risk.
• Identify programme risks and constraints — including weather, access, outage windows, and third-party dependencies — and escalate to the Project Manager with proposed mitigation actions.
• Support outage and switching coordination with SSEN Transmission's network operations team, ensuring all planned access windows are fully utilised and safety documentation is in place.
Health, Safety, Environment & Quality
• Assist with the implementation and monitoring of site Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) procedures, ensuring compliance with Omexom's SHEQ Management System, statutory legislation, and CDM Regulations 2015 at all times.
• Review and contribute to the preparation of Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS), ensuring they accurately reflect site conditions and are communicated and understood by all operatives prior to works commencing.
• Conduct routine site safety inspections and observations, recording findings and driving prompt close-out of any identified actions.
• Support the investigation and close-out of any safety incidents, near misses, or environmental non-conformances, contributing to lessons-learnt communications.
• Ensure that all site quality records — including inspection and test plans (ITPs), material conformance certificates, and as-built documentation — are maintained accurately and submitted to the client in accordance with the agreed quality management plan.
Commercial Awareness & Reporting
• Work closely with the Project Manager and commercial team to monitor project costs against budget, flagging variances and supporting the identification of commercial opportunities and risks.
• Assist in the preparation of monthly project progress reports, including programme status, resource utilisation, cost performance, and look-ahead narratives, for submission to the Business Unit General Manager and SSEN Transmission.
• Support the identification, notification, and substantiation of compensation events and change orders under the NEC contract, ensuring appropriate records are maintained to evidence entitlement.
• Contribute to the tendering process as required, including reviewing scope documents, developing method statements, and supporting the production of programme and resource submissions for bid returns.
Client & Stakeholder Interface
• Attend and contribute to regular site progress meetings, design coordination meetings, and client review sessions with SSEN Transmission, presenting updates on progress, quality, and upcoming activities.
• Maintain a professional and collaborative working relationship with all SSEN Transmission personnel — including project managers, engineers, network operations, and environmental representatives — to ensure effective co-operation throughout the project.
• Liaise with landowners, local authorities, utility companies, and other third parties as required to facilitate site access and resolve any interface issues affecting construction progress.
• Represent Omexom professionally at all times in client-facing and external stakeholder situations, upholding the values and reputation of the business.
---

Internal
• Business Unit General Manager
• Project Manager
• Design Engineers
• Commercial / Quantity Surveying Team
• SHEQ Team
• Site Engineers & Project Engineers
External
• SSEN Transmission (Project & Engineering Teams)
• SSEN Transmission Network Operations
• Subcontractors & Specialist Suppliers
• Landowners & Access Stakeholders
• Local Authorities & Statutory Bodies
---
Person Specification
Essential
• Extensive, proven site-based experience on OHL projects — either as a Project Engineer, Site Supervisor, or Senior Site Operative — with a sound understanding of OHL construction methods and sequencing across access, foundations, steelwork, and stringing activities.
• Working knowledge of Health & Safety legislation applicable to OHL construction, including CDM Regulations 2015, Electricity at Work Regulations 1989, and the Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity Regulations 2002.
• Familiarity with NEC3 or NEC4 contract frameworks, including programme management, compensation event administration, and cost reporting obligations.

Desirable

## Description
### Senior Quantum Engineer
At OQC, we aren’t just theorising about the future; we’re building it. Born from a philosophy of bold innovation, we’ve successfully transitioned quantum computing from an academic ambition into a commercial reality. The most exciting thing is that we’re just getting started.
### The Purpose
Lead scientific research that advances OQC’s quantum processors, superconducting circuit technology and supporting infrastructure.
As a Senior Quantum Engineer, you’ll own complex research projects across their full lifecycle—from defining scientific priorities and designing experiments through to implementation, data analysis and the communication of clear findings and recommendations. Your work will directly influence OQC’s technology roadmap and the performance of future quantum processing units.
### The Role
You’ll be a senior member of our Quantum Science & Exploratory Research team, combining hands-on experimental research with scientific leadership, project ownership and technical mentoring.
Working across superconducting quantum circuits, processor characterisation, calibration, benchmarking and cryogenic measurement systems, you’ll investigate the limitations of existing technologies and explore new approaches to qubit design, packaging and quantum-processing infrastructure.
You’ll also help shape the QSER roadmap, coordinate the resources required to deliver experimental programmes and support the development of Quantum Engineers across the team.
### What You’ll Be Working On
* Lead complex scientific research projects from initial concept and experimental design through to implementation, analysis, reporting and technical recommendations.
* Design, simulate and characterise novel superconducting components for quantum processing and its supporting infrastructure.
* Measure, calibrate and benchmark superconducting quantum circuits, developing meaningful performance metrics and investigating QPU design or processor limitations.
* Lead research into alternative qubit architectures and packaging implementations, translating experimental evidence into recommendations for future technology development.
* Coordinate the scheduling, resourcing and operation of quantum-processing infrastructure, including multiple cryogenic systems, control electronics and measurement equipment.
* Contribute to the QSER technology roadmap by reporting progress, assessing the feasibility of milestones and recommending future scientific priorities.
* Mentor Quantum Engineers, maintain high-quality project documentation and represent OQC through conferences, research collaborations and scientific publications.
### What We’re Looking For
* A degree in physics, quantum engineering, electrical engineering or another relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience owning research projects involving the measurement, characterisation or operation of quantum systems.
* Hands-on experience running experimental quantum-computing measurements, benchmarking processes or operational methods within an academic or industrial environment.
* Experience creating or running simulations of the quantum or radio-frequency properties of superconducting circuits.
* Strong scientific programming skills, particularly Python or a comparable language, for experimental automation and data analysis.
* The ability to analyse complex datasets, identify meaningful patterns and use evidence to support technical decisions.
* Strong project leadership or project-management skills, including the ability to balance scientific objectives, resources, timelines and budget implications.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distil complex scientific information for different technical audiences.
* A creative and innovative approach to scientific problem-solving, combined with the confidence to influence technical direction.
* The ability to mentor colleagues, delegate technical tasks and support the development of less-experienced Quantum Engineers.
### The ‘Nice-to-Haves’
* A PhD in physics, quantum engineering, electrical engineering or a closely related field.
* Experience using or developing microwave-frequency control hardware for superconducting quantum systems.
* Scientific publication experience, particularly within superconducting circuits, quantum measurement or related areas.
* Experience presenting research findings at conferences, technical reviews or collaborative research forums.
* Hands-on experience preparing, handling and installing samples within cryogenic enclosures.
* Knowledge of the specification, installation and maintenance of RF or DC wiring.
* Experience operating and maintaining cryogenic refrigeration and vacuum systems.
* Experience developing remote-operation or automation methods for low-noise measurements.
* Strong planning, organisational and scientific judgement skills.
### Why Join OQC
You’ll join a multidisciplinary team working at the forefront of superconducting quantum computing, with the opportunity to take genuine ownership of research that informs both near-term engineering decisions and OQC’s longer-term technology direction.
This is an opportunity to combine deep scientific work with visible technical leadership—investigating novel quantum technologies, working directly with advanced cryogenic and measurement infrastructure, and helping develop the people and research capabilities that will support OQC’s next generation of quantum processors.
