# **The Role**
Our Sample Technology team is responsible for the specification, development and performance of the company’s suite of nucleic acid sample preparation kits, and the development of end-to-end sample-to-answer workflows, all intimately associated with our sequencing platforms (e.g. MinION/GridION and PromethION).
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual with relevant lab-based skills to join the team as a Development Scientist. The role is based at our Oxford headquarters and involves laboratory-based development, characterisation, troubleshooting and performance improvement across DNA and RNA sample-preparation workflows.

* Routine use of our nanopore-based single molecule assays.

* Practical working knowledge of chromatographic (HPLC/LC-MS) methods for analysis or purification of DNA/RNA, proteins, small molecules or complex mixtures.

* Ability to maintain accurate experimental records and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical colleagues.
# **Desirable Experience**
* Knowledge of chromatography method development.
* Experience with assay optimisation, oligonucleotide design, library preparation, ONT platforms or other NGS technologies.
* Ability to analyse and visualise experimental data using Python, R, command-line tools or equivalent methods.

* PhD in Biochemistry, Chemistry or a related field, or equivalent industrial/applied research experience.

The code you write here will be used by millions of customers. Every booking, every search, every confirmation email. That's the product.

* Frontend architecture and performance: component design, state, rendering, and the details that make a dense tool feel light
* Trust surfaces such as provenance, citations and confidence, rendered so a scientist can check the work behind any answer

* Close work with founders, customers and domain experts, turning ambiguity into shipped product

The people who do well here find that kind of ownership and growth exciting, and they weren't looking for a nine-to-five.

***Hello*, we’re Pret**
Proud makers of freshly made food, organic coffee and big ideas. Across 750+ shops and 20+ countries, our teams are shaping the future of Pret through innovation, inclusion, great customer service and a shared passion for doing the right thing. We’re growing fast on our mission to be the hospitality employer of choice everywhere we operate – so it’s an exciting time to hop on board.
**Growing *good* things**
Pret is where passionate, hardworking, wonderful people (like you!) find what they need to shine. Growth is at the heart of everything we do – from supporting our people to grow in confidence and skills to pursue their unique paths, to figuring out how to make our food and coffee even *more* delicious and accessible.
**Now, on to the AI Business Analyst role...**
The AI Business Analyst will report to the Strategy & Transformation Director and play a central role in helping Pret redesign how work gets done across our global functions. This is not a traditional business analysis role. The focus is to identify, shape and deliver practical opportunities to embed generative AI, agentic AI and automation into business processes in a way that improves productivity, decision-making, customer experience and team effectiveness. You will work across Support Centre functions, shops, markets, franchise partners, technology teams and third-party suppliers to understand current ways of working, challenge existing processes and design future-state workflows that make intelligent use of tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT and other emerging AI platforms. The role will combine strong business analysis fundamentals with AI fluency, process redesign, change management and adoption expertise. You will translate business opportunities into clear requirements, use cases, experiments and implementation plans, ensuring that AI-enabled solutions are useful, safe, scalable and adopted by the teams they are designed to support.
***The responsibilities***
* Partner with business stakeholders across Pret to identify, assess and prioritise opportunities where generative AI, agentic AI, automation or improved data workflows could simplify processes, reduce manual effort, improve decision-making or unlock new capability.
* Lead discovery and process redesign workshops to map current-state ways of working, uncover pain points, identify root causes and define future-state AI-enabled workflows across functions such as Marketing, Operations, Food, Finance, People, Technology and Supply Chain.
* Translate business problems into clear AI use cases, user journeys, requirements, success measures, guardrails, data needs and delivery plans that can be understood by both business and technical teams.
* Working with Engineers to design practical agentic and generative AI workflows, including prompts, inputs, outputs, human-in-the-loop controls, escalation points, decision rights, audit requirements and operational ownership models.
* Work with technology, data, security, legal and delivery partners to ensure AI-enabled solutions are feasible, compliant, secure, well governed and aligned with Pret’s technology standards, policies and data protection requirements.
* Support the delivery of proof of concepts, pilots and scaled rollouts, including requirements definition, backlog shaping & prioritisation, acceptance criteria, testing, business readiness, launch planning and early-life support.
* Develop benefit cases and value-tracking approaches for AI initiatives, including productivity gains, revenue growth, cost savings, adoption and team experience.
* Support Finance with cost tracking of token usage across different use cases across the business
* Use AI tools in your own BA practice to accelerate requirements gathering, meeting synthesis, process documentation, user story creation, options analysis and executive-ready communication.
* Create clear process maps, business requirements, AI workflow specifications, testing criteria, training materials, adoption plans and stakeholder communications that enable teams to understand and confidently adopt new ways of working.
* Establish, maintain and govern reusable AI enablement repositories, including prompt libraries, workflow templates, approved use cases, playbooks, training materials and examples, ensuring content is version-controlled, quality assured, easy to access and kept up to date as tools and processes evolve.
* Plan and support change management activity, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, coaching, adoption measurement and feedback loops to ensure new tools and processes are embedded sustainably.
* Monitor live AI-enabled processes after launch, capturing user feedback, identifying issues, refining workflows and ensuring benefits are realised without compromising control, quality or accountability.
***The perks***
* An annual salary of £60,000 per year and 10% bonus potential
* A Gold Card! That means when you’re in the office, your food and drinks are on us. And when you’re not, you get 5 free drinks a day and 50% off everything else
* 33-38 days of annual leave (increasing with service)
* Free private medical aid cover – with the option to add a loved one
* 4-5% pension contribution (increasing with service)
* Life assurance at 3x your annual salary
* Loyalty awards to celebrate every 5 years you’re with us
* And *more* – think: a flexible benefits platform, season ticket loans, a healthcare cash plan, mortgage services, financial wellbeing provisions, option to take a sabbatical after 3 years and opportunities to support our incredible charity, the Pret Foundation.
***Your skills and experience***
* Strong business analysis experience, ideally with at least 3 years in process improvement, transformation, technology delivery, digital change or operational excellence roles.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, Power Apps, Azure AI Services, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or similar platforms to improve productivity, analysis, documentation or business workflows.
* Strong understanding of how generative AI and agentic AI can be applied to business processes, including practical awareness of prompts, context, data quality, workflow automation, human review and responsible AI guardrails.
* Proven ability to map, analyse and redesign end-to-end business processes using recognised methods such as BPMN 2.0, service blueprints, customer journeys, operating models, RACI models and user stories.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a multi-site or multi-country organisation, ideally across functions such as Marketing, Operations, Food, Finance, People, Digital, Technology or Supply Chain
* Ability to shape ambiguous business problems into clear opportunity statements, prioritised use cases, business requirements, pilots and measurable implementation plans.
* Good understanding of data concepts, including data sources, data quality, data protection, access controls and the importance of trusted business context when applying AI to enterprise workflows.
* Experience supporting business change, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, adoption planning, benefit tracking and early-life support.
* Comfortable working with technology and delivery teams, including product owners, engineers, data teams, security, legal, vendors and implementation partners.
* Confident using tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude Cowork, PowerPoint, Excel, Visio, Confluence, Jira, Miro, Teams, SharePoint and AI-enabled productivity tools to create high-quality analysis, documentation and communication materials.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical topics, influence senior stakeholders and bring colleagues on the journey from idea to adoption.
* Curious, structured and pragmatic, with the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and the judgement to know when AI is useful, when it is risky and when a simpler process change is the better answer.
**Life at Pret**
***In the office***
You’ll be based at our Head Office in London Victoria. AKA the Support Centre, or 75B (a throwback to our roots). Here, you’ll find:
* Individual ways to grow: fully funded professional qualifications, leadership development and informal and formal mentoring
* Diversity & belonging: Everyone’s welcome at Pret – you’ll be valued for who you are and supported to feel confident in yourself and your skills
* Pace & variety: Build a diverse skillset, meet some new people and learn (a LOT)
* Community & purpose: We work together to creative positive change through the Pret Foundation
***Our values***
* Be kind, honest and generous: bring genuine warmth and your authentic self to work every day
* Bring your passion: share our passion for food and exceptional customer service
* Spread joy every day: small acts of kindness are a big part of what makes the Pret experience special
**The Pret interview journey**
Step one: apply! Please don’t *overly rely* on the use AI, we want to get to know *you*, not a robot (...we get the irony!)
Then, if we move forward with your application, we’ll start the process with a 30-minute chat, so we can better understand your experience and skills. The next stage is to pop into our Head Office, where you’ll have a one-hour interview with the hiring team.
Those are the basics, but depending on the role, we might ask you to complete a task, spend time in our shops or meet someone else in the team.
Throughout it all, you are entitled to reasonable adjustments if you have a disability. If this is the case, please let us know how we can help make the process more accessible for you.

# Senior Software Engineer - Java, Trading & Liquidity
**About Quidax**
Quidax is where money meets limitless possibilities. We're making it super easy for individuals, businesses, and fintechs in Africa to access crypto. Our goal? Providing real value for our customers today while shaping the future of money.
**About the Role**
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Trading & Liquidity squad and build the systems that power the heart of Quidax.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving hard backend problems where reliability, performance, and correctness matter. You'll build and operate Java services that power trading, pricing, liquidity, order execution, settlement, and exchange integrations. These are systems where milliseconds matter, failures have financial impact, and every design decision counts. You’ll thrive here if you’ve built transaction-heavy financial systems before, enjoy thinking deeply about distributed systems and concurrency, and love taking ownership of critical services from design through production.
**What You’ll Be Owning**
**Build & Own Critical Trading Services**
* Design, build, deploy, and operate scalable Java services powering trading, pricing, execution, and liquidity.
* Own critical backend services end to end, from architecture and implementation to production support and continuous improvement.
* Build systems that remain reliable under heavy traffic, partial failures, and changing market conditions.
**Trading, Execution & Liquidity**
* Develop and improve order management, execution, pricing, market data, and liquidity management capabilities.
* Build and maintain integrations with exchanges, liquidity providers, custodians, payment providers, and other external platforms.
* Improve execution quality through better pricing accuracy, spreads, fill rates, liquidity availability, and reduced slippage.
**Build Reliable Financial Systems**
* Design reliable order lifecycles covering validation, routing, execution, settlement, reconciliation, cancellations, retries, and recovery.
* Ensure financial correctness across balances, positions, fees, and settlements through precision, idempotency, consistency, and auditability.
* Build distributed systems that behave correctly under concurrency, retries, duplicate events, and eventual consistency.
**Improve Performance & Reliability**
* Continuously improve system performance, resilience, observability, throughput, and operational readiness.
* Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements.
* Build testing strategies covering unit, integration, contract, performance, and resilience testing.
**Raise the Engineering Bar**
* Participate in architecture and technical design decisions across the Trading & Liquidity squad.
* Review code, mentor engineers, and help raise engineering standards across the team.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Platform, QA, Security, Compliance, Risk, Finance, and Operations to deliver reliable financial systems.
**Biggest Challenges You’ll Tackle**
This isn't a role where you're simply building APIs.
* You'll be solving engineering problems where correctness, speed, and resilience all matter at the same time.
* Some of the challenges you'll tackle include:
* Building systems that continue operating reliably during volatile market conditions.
* Designing distributed systems that remain consistent despite failures, retries, and duplicate events.
* Improving latency and execution quality without sacrificing correctness.
* Managing concurrency, race conditions, transaction boundaries, and eventual consistency across critical financial systems.
* Building exchange and liquidity-provider integrations that remain resilient when external systems fail.
* Delivering systems where balances, settlements, and financial records remain accurate and fully auditable.
**What We're Looking For**
We're looking for someone who enjoys owning complex backend systems and takes pride in building software that performs reliably in production.
**Experience**
* 5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience.
* Strong commercial experience building Java backend systems.
* Proven experience with Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem.
* Experience owning production systems from design through operation.
* Experience building distributed systems, microservices, or event-driven architectures.
* Experience working in trading, crypto, exchanges, capital markets, payments, or other transaction-heavy financial environments.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices.
**Technical Skills**
You should have strong practical experience across most of the following areas:
* **Java:** JVM fundamentals, memory management, collections, generics, concurrency and multithreading, streams, performance optimisation, exception handling, and functional programming.
* **Spring Ecosystem:** Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, dependency injection, transaction management, scheduling, validation, and configuration.
* **Databases:** PostgreSQL or MySQL, SQL optimisation, indexing, transactions, isolation levels, data modelling, and connection pooling.
* **Distributed Systems:** Microservices, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, Kafka or RabbitMQ, service communication, eventual consistency, distributed transactions, idempotency, retries, caching, and failure recovery.
* **Cloud & DevOps:** Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, monitoring, logging, tracing, observability, and production operations.
* **Security:** Authentication, authorisation, API security, secure coding practices, secrets management, OAuth2, JWT, and OpenID Connect.
**Trading & Liquidity Knowledge**
You'll be comfortable working with concepts such as:
* Order books and matching engines.
* Market, limit, and stop orders.
* Bid/ask pricing, spreads, liquidity, and slippage.
* Order routing and execution.
* Market data and pricing feeds.
* Exchange and liquidity-provider integrations.
* Settlement, reconciliation, balances, and positions.
* Decimal precision and financial calculations.
* Risk controls and abnormal market behaviour.
**You'll Stand Out If You**
* Take ownership of systems rather than just writing code.
* Enjoy solving production problems and improving reliability.
* Can clearly explain technical decisions and trade-offs.
* Raise the quality of engineering through mentoring and code reviews.
* Stay calm when solving complex production incidents.
* Care deeply about building systems that customers can trust.
**Reporting Line**
You'll report to the Engineering Manager for the Trading & Liquidity squad and work closely with Product, Platform, QA, Security, Compliance, Risk, Finance, and Operations to build reliable financial systems.
**Why Quidax**
At Quidax, we’re building the future of finance in Africa through crypto. You’ll have the freedom to innovate, the space to lead, and the backing to build something that truly scales. If you’re ready to build an engineering org that delivers excellence at scale, let’s talk.
**What’s In It For You**When you join Quidax, you’re not just taking a job, you’re jumping into a community that’s bold, remote-first, and building for the future. Here’s what you get:
**💰 Fair Pay + Ownership**
* Competitive salary based on your skills and experience; annual merit-based reviews to keep your growth visible and rewarded
**🚀 Growth That’s Real**
* Annual performance reviews + clear promotion cycles; recognition for great work, from shoutouts to milestone rewards
* Personal development fund (courses, books, conferences); study leave so you can keep learning
**🧘🏾 Work That Works For You**
* Fully remote forever + flexible working hours
**❤️ Time Off That Respects Life**

* Parental, sick, compassionate, and life event leave; we show up for you
**🌍 Connection That Feels Real**
* Quarterly remote team hangouts + annual offsite; interest-based communities (SIGs)
* Regular engagement surveys; your voice matters

**TL;DR:**You’ll do meaningful work, grow fast, and have the flexibility to live your best life, all while building something big with people who care.
Let’s build the future of finance together 💜

We love seeing applications that speak directly to us. It’s easy for your application to get lost in a sea of generic ones, especially when we’re sorting through dozens of them. So, make yours stand out! Show us your personality, your passion, and why you’re the perfect fit. We appreciate the effort it takes to create something thoughtful and unique.

## Teamwork makes the stream work.
### **Roku is changing how the world watches TV**
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
### What does the team work on?
This team spends most of its time building and improving the UI framework and components that power Roku user experiences. Our roadmap helps us accelerate our growth and scale, putting surprising new features into the hands of tens of millions of Roku users worldwide.
Our developers and engineers are owners. They are motivated from within, finding and taking on a feature or project simply because that problem needs to be solved and shipped. But that individual must work together with different engineering teams, UI design, product teams, and business leadership to make things happen, which means that engineers succeed here because they can maintain that independent spirit and motivation within a deeply collaborative environment. We are the pragmatic dreamers inventing and re-inventing the world of streaming media.
### ### What is the role?
Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The Senior Software Engineer, UI Infrastructure will contribute extensively to the embedded UI framework development, working closely with system architects to develop new features and extend current capabilities to improve system stability and performance. This role involves developing, maintaining, and enhancing the high-performance grid rendering component that powers Roku's app engine, while also building tools to support the broader development community within Roku. You will use agentic coding to accelerate feature development and testing, and collaborate with cross-functional teams including the Home Screen and EPG teams to integrate feature requests and optimize UI responsiveness. The features and performance improvements you implement directly impact millions of users every day, making this an excellent opportunity for an experienced professional who has innovative ideas for complex problems and can translate them into ultra-reliable software.
### ### How will I use AI at Roku?
At Roku, AI agents do most of the keystroke-level coding. Engineers act as the technical leads for those agents — setting context, planning work, verifying outputs, and recovering when the agent goes off course. If you are excited about working this way, we want to talk to you.
You have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. At Roku, we're embracing AI as a powerful tool to amplify human creativity, accelerate innovation, and deliver better results for our customers. Across teams, we're exploring how AI can enhance our work — and we're only looking for people who are curious, adaptable, and excited to grow alongside these technologies.
### ### What are the responsibilities of the role?
* Develop, maintain, and enhance the high-performance grid rendering component that powers Roku's app engine
* Use agentic coding to accelerate feature development and testing
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including the Home Screen and EPG teams to integrate feature requests and optimize UI responsiveness
* Implement unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure high-quality user experiences across Roku devices
* Apply deep knowledge of Linux and OS concepts to improve system stability and performance
* Work autonomously in a distributed team environment, communicating effectively across time zones and locations
* Participate in design discussions and code reviews to uphold best practices in embedded C++ development and system architecture
### ### What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
* 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on embedded systems or UI performance
* Strong proficiency in C++ programming, with experience developing and optimizing rendering engines or UI frameworks
* Experience building JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks or working on JS virtual machines and runtimes
* Solid understanding of Linux OS concepts and experience working in Linux-based environments
* Experience with test automation as part of the software development lifecycle
* Familiarity with embedded development principles, particularly in mid-level firmware or system software
* Ability to work independently and asynchronously in a distributed team environment across multiple time zones
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
* A track record of delivering high-performance user experiences through efficient and maintainable code

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
### **What are some of the benefits?**
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. ## Role Overview
* **Position:** Curriculum Developer / Writer
* **Organisation:** Safar Publications Ltd
* **Location:** London or Manchester, hybrid working pattern
* **Reports to:** Programme Manager, Development Division
* **Contract:** Full-time (part-time considered)
* **Salary:** Competitive, based on skills and experience
## About Safar Publications
Safar Publications is a subsidiary of Safar Academy Trust. We equip learners, teachers and institutions with resources that make Islamic learning meaningful, engaging and effective in today's world. We provide educators with comprehensive, holistic teaching materials supported by innovative digital tools, high-quality training and ongoing development. Our strengths are in-depth research, accuracy, authenticity, child-centred design and contemporary relevance.
Our range of products and services includes:
* A comprehensive curriculum (textbooks and workbooks) consisting of interlinking syllabi covering Islamic Studies, Tajwīd and Qirāʾah, Duʿāʾs & Sūrahs and Arabic language.
* Teaching resources and teacher tools (teacher guides, classroom resources and assessments).
* A digital ecosystem which includes a digital learning platform and digital applications.
## About This Recruitment
We are recruiting two Curriculum Developer / Writer roles simultaneously. While the responsibilities, day-to-day work and team culture are the same, we are looking for candidates who bring different, complementary strengths. Both roles are open to the same application process; you do not need to specify which profile you are applying for.
Both profiles require a grounding in Islamic Studies and familiarity with Arabic. This is a baseline for all candidates. Profile A brings scholarly depth; Profile B brings classroom expertise. The two hires are designed to bring complementary strengths to the wider development team.
### Profile A: Islamic Studies and Arabic Specialist
* **Primary background** Islamic studies qualification (ʿAlimiyyah, BA Islamic Studies or equivalent)
* **Subject focus** Competent engagement with Islamic sources, fiqh, ʿulūm al-Qurʾān, Tajwīd, theology and related disciplines
* **Key strength** Theological accuracy, Arabic-source text engagement, fiqh awareness
* **Brings to the team** Scholarly credibility and authentic grounding for content across all curriculum areas
### Profile B: Classroom Practitioner
* **Primary background** Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) with 2+ years classroom teaching experience
* **Subject focus** Islamic Studies grounding (as per all-candidates baseline) plus wider curriculum education: humanities, RE, PSHE or related subjects
* **Key strength** Pedagogical rigour, lesson design, curriculum mapping, classroom reality
* **Brings to the team** Educational best practice and a learner/teacher-facing perspective
## Job Summary
As a Curriculum Developer / Writer, you will create engaging, accurate and pedagogically sound Muslim educational content for a range of age groups. You will contribute to textbooks, workbooks, teacher guides, assessments, digital resources and training materials, helping Safar produce high-quality learning materials rooted in Islamic tradition and relevant to today's learners.
This role suits someone who delivers strong written work in a dynamic environment and approaches curriculum development with clarity, structure and purpose. You will apply your subject knowledge and educational insight to produce content that is both meaningful and practical for teachers and students.
You must be able to manage your workload independently, conduct focused research and writing tasks, and meet deadlines reliably. While maintaining close attention to detail, you will also appreciate how your work fits into Safar's broader vision and the needs of Muslim learners, schools and communities. The role requires developing a broad understanding of the context in which our products are used, recognising how political, economic, social, technological, legal and community factors influence and shape the curriculum we design.
## Core Responsibilities
* Researching, planning and developing curriculum content (digital and print) across Islamic Studies, Tarbiyah, Qur'an, Arabic and related strands, covering all of Safar's learning series.
* Producing high-quality student-facing and teacher-facing materials, including textbooks, workbooks, lesson plans and teacher guides, ensuring all content is accurate, grounded in Islamic sources, accessible to learners and compliant with Safar's guidelines and house style.
* Simplifying complex concepts into clear, meaningful learning experiences, applying child-centred pedagogy when designing explanations, activities and learning outcomes.
* Knowing when and how to draw on PSHE, SMSC, RE and other educational frameworks alongside Safar's own learning domains and Tarbiyah framework, applying them where they genuinely serve the content and the learner.
* Collaborating effectively internally and externally: with editors, designers, subject-matter specialists and customer insight leads throughout the development process.
* Managing your own workload across concurrent projects, meeting agreed deadlines, flagging risks early and reporting progress clearly to the Programme Manager.
* Implementing and supporting quality standards and assurance processes for both new and existing products.
* Staying informed about sector trends, innovations and developments to help ensure Safar's products remain current, competitive and relevant.
## What You Will Get From the Role
Safar's resources are used by tens of thousands of Muslim learners across the UK and beyond. The work you produce here will shape how young people understand their faith, their identity and their place in the world, and it will do so for years after you write it.
You will work at the intersection of Islamic scholarship and contemporary education, engaging with subject specialists, educators and researchers as a genuine collaborator. Producing content that is both deeply rooted and genuinely relevant requires hard thinking, something Safar takes seriously.
You will develop specialist expertise that is rare: in curriculum writing, in Islamic educational publishing and in the particular craft of making complex ideas clear for young people and wider users.
## Person Specification
### Essential Criteria — All Candidates
* A grounding in Islamic Studies and familiarity with Arabic sufficient to engage confidently with the content being written.
* Excellent written English, with close attention to detail.
* Ability to write clearly for multiple age groups.
* Experience producing teacher-facing and student-facing content.
* Proven skill in simplifying complex concepts for young people.
* Strong organisational and communication skills.
* Experience working in a project delivery environment where priorities can shift and fast-paced delivery is required.
### Profile A — Essential Criteria
* Formal Islamic studies qualification (e.g. ʿAlimiyyah, BA in Islamic Studies or equivalent).
* Ability to reference Arabic sources and engage with classical and contemporary scholarship.
### Profile B — Essential Criteria
* Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) or equivalent teaching qualification.
* Minimum two years of classroom teaching experience in a school setting.
* Demonstrable understanding of lesson planning, learning objectives and curriculum sequencing for ages 5–16.
* Subject matter familiarity with Islamic Studies content, sufficient to write accurately and engage critically with source material, even where scholarly depth is provided by colleagues.
* Working familiarity with Arabic: able to read and engage with transliterated or Arabic-script terms and references within an Islamic Studies curriculum context.
### Desirable Criteria
* Experience in curriculum design or educational publishing.
* Understanding of industry educational frameworks (e.g. UK National Curriculum, PSHE, SMSC, RE).
* Familiarity with educational research or evidence-based pedagogy.
* Bachelor's degree in arts, humanities or education.
* Experience producing creative or multimedia resources.
### Core Strengths and Behaviours
* **A team player:** Works well with others, supports colleagues and contributes positively to shared goals. Open to feedback and committed to improving both self and team. Finds time and is enthusiastic about collaborative projects within Safar.
* **A motivated self-starter:** Takes initiative, works independently and delivers high-quality work without close supervision. Manages time well and maintains strong personal accountability.
* **Curious and a lateral thinker:** Asks thoughtful questions, thinks beyond the obvious and makes connections across ideas. Able to follow specifications carefully while also offering creative and well-reasoned improvements.
* **Resilient and adaptable:** Copes well with change, shifting priorities and fast-paced environments. Stays calm, focused and willing to learn in the face of uncertainty.
* **Aligned with Safar's ethos:** Brings a spirit of iḥsān to their work: committed to accuracy, authenticity and child-centred design, and to producing content that is both Islamically grounded and genuinely relevant to young Muslims today.
## Benefits
Alongside your salary:
* Learning and development tailored to your role.
* Leave: if you work full-time at Safar, you are entitled to 33 days of leave (including eight bank holidays and two days for Eid).
* The opportunity to contribute to high-quality Islamic education that will benefit learners for generations.
* A supportive, values-led working environment focused on purpose, quality and professional growth.
* The chance to develop specialist expertise in curriculum and textbook writing within a growing educational organisation.
* Access to research resources and relevant books located at Safar's London office to support high-quality curriculum and textbook writing.
## Application Process
### Application Stage
As part of the application process, you will be asked to submit a CV and responses to the questions below. The CV should include your job history, qualification details and experience.
**Q1: Short video (2–3 minutes)** Tell us who you are, what draws you to Safar's work and why this role is the right next step for you.
**Q2: Written response** Describe your background and the experience most relevant to this role. What have you produced that you are most proud of, and what made it good?
**Q3: Written response** The balance we aim to strike in everything we produce is this: deep rootedness in Islamic tradition and real relevance for young Muslims growing up in modern societies. It sounds simple, but it's where most of the hard thinking happens. Where have you had to hold that balance in your own work, and what did it look like?
*For written responses, max word limit of 250–300.*
### Interview
If you are successful at the application stage, you will be invited to an interview where we will assess your experience, behaviours and technical skills.
Shortlisted candidates will also complete a written exercise as part of the interview process. You will be given a chapter specification, and the task will evaluate your writing ability, your understanding of the brief and your capacity to translate the brief into clear, accurate and age-appropriate textbook content that is pedagogically sound.
### Using Artificial Intelligence
Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a helpful tool when preparing your application. You may use AI to refine and clarify your ideas, check spelling and grammar, and improve the clarity of what you have written. However, all information you submit must remain truthful, accurate and based on your own personal experience and understanding. Should you opt to use AI for the application and written exercise, you will be required to disclose this.
Any written exercises or examples must reflect your genuine work. Content that is fully generated by AI, or copied from other sources and presented as your own, may be considered plagiarism. Applications containing such material may be withdrawn, and internal candidates may face disciplinary action. You are responsible for ensuring that all submissions are original, authentic and genuinely yours.

# Tribe Lead - ( Software) Engineering Centre of Excllence
## At SD Worx, we are looking for energetic people to join our team. With us, you get the chance to showcase your talents and grow like never before! Ready, set, apply!
We usually respond within a week
SD Worx is a leading payroll and HR technology company in Europe, serving millions of employees in over 27 countries. We are transforming from a traditional SaaS software organization into an AI-native technology company. This transition involves more than just adopting new tools, we aim to move away from manual coding and embrace orchestration, code review, and AI-enhanced craftsmanship. We are looking for a Tribe Lead for our Software Engineering Centre of Excellence (CoE) to drive this transformation.
The CoE will establish engineering excellence by improving engineering maturity, adopting AI-native practices, setting modern standards, and fostering continuous learning and innovation. In this role, you won’t manage day-to-day project delivery. Instead, you'll serve as a strategic advisor focused on high-impact initiatives that enhance our software engineering practices across the organisation.
Your goal is to define our "Operating System" for engineering, transitioning us from a service provider to a technology powerhouse through advanced AI and industry-leading standards. The future of software engineering involves orchestrating AI agents to generate, analyse, test, secure, and optimise software, allowing engineers to focus on architecture, validation, governance, and complex problem-solving. This is a strategic leadership role aimed at increasing the effectiveness and maturity of our software engineering efforts.
**About the role:**
As Tribe Lead of the CoE, you will define world-class software engineering at SD Worx. You’ll advise engineering leadership on trends, modern practices, and AI-native development to accelerate our evolution into a modern technology company. Your responsibilities include improving engineering capabilities, driving AI adoption, and embedding excellence across every engineering team. Rather than overseeing daily delivery, you will set standards, influence culture, coach leaders, and ensure our practices keep pace with technological change. **Your Mission** - Lead the Software Engineering Centre of Excellence to improve engineering maturity at SD Worx.
* AI-Native Engineering Transformation Define the collaboration between engineers and AI throughout the Software Development Lifecycle. Evolve engineers from software developers to AI-powered engineering orchestrators. Promote the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic software engineering in design, coding, testing, documentation, operations, and continuous improvement.
* Orchestrate AI Transformation:- Set standards for how humans and AI collaborate in designing, reviewing, and delivering software.
* Drive Engineering Excellence:- Advise teams on modern engineering practices and establish common engineering standards, quality practices, and governance to enable faster, more secure, and consistent software delivery while preserving team autonomy.
* Set the Bar: Create non-negotiable standards for quality and security to ensure that autonomy does not compromise coherence
* Increase Software Engineering Maturity: Continuously enhance capabilities across SD Worx by adopting modern practices, benchmarking against leading companies, and implementing engineering maturity models for ongoing improvement.
**Key Impact Areas**
1. Driving the AI-Native Transformation
* Define and execute the strategy for AI-augmented engineering (GitHub Copilot, agentic workflows, automated remediation).
* Move the organization from "experimenting with AI" to standardizing it as a core competency, measuring the impact on velocity and code quality.
* Modernize our approach to legacy systems, using AI to accelerate refactoring and reduce technical debt.
* Drive the shift from "developer-as-coder" to "developer-as-orchestrator," ensuring our teams effectively leverage agentic AI to manage complex workflows.
* Define the metrics for "AI-augmented productivity," focusing on how AI accelerates the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and improves output quality.
2. Advancing Engineering Maturity
* Act as the primary advisor to leadership on emerging industry standards in software engineering, ensuring SD Worx remains competitive with top-tier technology companies.
* Design and deploy "Engineering Crews"—swat teams of experts who embed with tribes to solve critical bottlenecks and upskill teams on advanced technical patterns.
* Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement, utilizing data-driven insights to elevate our engineering rigor and craftsmanship.
3. Governance & Technical Standards
* Manage the maturity model for our internal engineering practices, providing a clear roadmap for tribes to transition high-performing, AI-augmented states.
* Improve Developer Experience (DevEx) by reducing engineering friction and increasing engineering effectiveness.
* Advise leadership on emerging engineering trends, technology strategy and engineering organisational design.
4. Cultivating Talent & Community
* Lead the SD Worx Campus team and Practice Guilds (Frontend, Backend, QA) to drive peer-to-peer learning and standardization.
* Design career paths that reward both deep specialization (T-shaped skills) and high-leverage generalists.
Success Metrics
* Engineering Maturity Index: Measurable increase in adherence to group engineering standards and best practices using DORA metrics.
* AI Adoption Velocity: Adoption rate of agentic AI workflows across tribes and the measurable impact on code quality and review cycles.
* Quality & Security Velocity: Reduction in technical debt and successful integration of automated, friction-free quality gates.
* DevEx Satisfaction: Improvement in developer experience scores as teams focus on high-leverage work rather than manual toil.
**What do you have to offer?**
* Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years leading engineering transformation, or developer experience at scale (500+ engineers), Engineering Excellence or Centre of Excellence initiatives within large-scale technology organisations.
* The "Change Agent" Gene: You have a track record of shifting engineering culture. You know how to sell a vision, build coalitions, and overcome resistance.
* AI Pragmatism: You are hands-on with the latest AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, etc.) and understand the difference between hype and genuine productivity gains.
* Product Mindset: You don't just build tools; you solve problems for your internal customers. You use data to prioritize.
* Technical Depth: Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, DevOps patterns, and security-by-design. Experience influencing senior engineering leadership and driving organisation-wide technical change. You can debate architecture with Principal Engineers.
* Passion for continuously evaluating emerging engineering practices and translating them into measurable business value.
**Leadership**
* Leadership Style: Collaborative, empathetic, and "servant-leader" oriented. You lead and coach through influence and value creation, not command-and-control.
* You are a recognised engineering leader who influences through technical credibility, collaboration and vision.
* You build engineering communities, mentor senior technical leaders and create environments where engineering teams continuously improve.
**What do we have to offer?**
* A dynamic environment: flexible working hours and working from home
* Workation: possibility to work from any SD Worx location (4 weeks per year, EU only)
* Free language courses (during your working hours)
* Referral program
* Learning opportunities: through an individual development plan and professional training
* Career growth: whether you want to become more of an expert in your field or expand your knowledge horizontally, there’s always room to grow within SD Worx!
*As this is an international role open in multiple countries, the full benefits package depends on the specific location.* *Salary range information will be shared with candidates during the initial interaction with the Talent Acquisition team, either by phone or email.*
Why Join SD Worx?
Shape the Future: You will be the architect of our HR tech & services future, with the budget and C-level sponsorship to make real change.
Scale: Your decisions will impact 1,400+ people and products used across 27 countries.
This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of software engineering across one of Europe's largest HR technology organisations.
You will define how hundreds of engineers build software, accelerate SD Worx's transformation into an AI-native technology company, and establish the engineering standards, practices and capabilities that will enable the organisation to compete with the world's leading technology companies.
Innovation: We are committed to being a leader in AI adoption—you will have the resources to push the boundaries of what's possible.

# Solution Marketing Manager - Supplier Growth
**About Sedex**
Sedex is a trusted partner for over 100,000 businesses worldwide, helping them create **socially and environmentally sustainable supply chains**. Through our platform's powerful data insights and expert guidance, we simplify the management, assessment, and reporting of sustainability performance.
Our Vision is to be a leader in making global supply chains more socially and environmentally sustainable. Our Mission is to provide data-driven insights, accessible tools, and exceptional services that support businesses in improving environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and outcomes.
**The role**
We are seeking a **Solution Marketing Manager** – **Supplier Growth** to join our dynamic Marketing department. In this role, you will be instrumental in shaping how Sedex speaks to and supports its supplier members — the factories and sites that make up the majority of our membership, many of whom join because a customer asked them to.
Today, most of our marketing is aimed at the buyers who require audits. Suppliers, meanwhile, often don't see the full value of membership beyond the audit request itself. Your job is to change that: to clearly explain what a supplier gets when they join Sedex — one audit that can be shared across every customer relationship instead of repeated separately, structured support to fix any issues an audit finds, and visibility to new potential customers looking for verified, responsible suppliers.
You'll own the supplier-facing messaging and content strategy end to end, and work closely with Product and Customer Success to make sure what we build, and what we say, genuinely reflects what suppliers need.
**Key Responsibilities**
As a Solution Marketing Manager – Supplier Growth, you will:
***Define Supplier Positioning & Messaging:***
· Build and maintain clear, simple messaging that explains what supplier membership delivers — audit sharing, structured improvement support, and visibility to new customers.
· Recognise that suppliers aren't all the same: tailor messaging for single-site factories, multi-site enterprises, and growth-focused SMEs, each with different needs and concerns.
· Track how Sedex compares with other audit and certification schemes, and maintain a clear, honest answer to ‘why Sedex.’
***Market & Supplier Insights:***
· Run a regular programme of supplier interviews, surveys and renewal/churn analysis to keep messaging grounded in what suppliers actually think and feel.
· Translate new supply chain regulations (in the EU, Germany, the US and the UK) into plain language, showing suppliers how being prepared can become a competitive advantage.
***Create Impactful Marketing Collateral:***
· Produce supplier-facing content: webinars, blogs, checklists, guides, case studies, onboarding emails and renewal communications — in plain English, with translations coordinated for key regions.
· Lead supplier communications for product launches, feature releases and audit methodology updates.
***Cross-Functional Collaboration:***
· Work with Product to help shape features that matter most to suppliers, such as audit-sharing controls, benchmarking tools and self-assessment questionnaires.
· Partner with Customer Success to build a regular feedback loop from the team that speaks to suppliers every day.
· Partner with Demand Generation, providing the audience segments, messages and offers they use to run campaigns.
***Performance Analysis & Reporting:***
· Track and report monthly on supplier engagement with content and messaging, and its impact on renewals.
· Use insights to continuously refine positioning, content and enablement materials.
**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**
· Proven experience (at least 3 yrs) in product or solution marketing for a B2B SaaS company
· Experience explaining products that become more valuable as more people use them, such as a supplier network, benchmarking community, or marketplace.
· A portfolio of shipped marketing content: at least one case study, one messaging framework, and one email sequence.
· Experience marketing to non-Western, small-business or multilingual audiences — our suppliers are mostly based in Asia, Latin America and Africa.
· Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to turn customer feedback and renewal data into clear recommendations.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas simply and persuasively.
· Organisational skills to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and handle shifting priorities effectively.
· Nice to have: direct experience with Sedex, SMETA audits, or similar schemes such as amfori, EcoVadis or SA8000
**Our culture**
At Sedex, our approach to business and culture is firmly rooted in our core values, which guide everything we do:
· **Respect Each Other**: We believe that a foundation of mutual respect is essential to creating a positive and inclusive environment.
· **Customer-Driven**: We are passionate about delivering exceptional value to our customers. By listening to their needs, understanding their challenges, and continuously adapting our solutions, we aim to empower them to achieve their sustainability goals and drive positive change in their supply chains.
· **Thinking Creatively**: Innovation is at the heart of our work. We encourage creative problem-solving and embrace new ideas that challenge the status quo. This mindset allows us to continuously improve our products and services, offering fresh and effective solutions to complex sustainability and ethical sourcing issues.
· **Take Ownership**: We empower our team members to take responsibility for their actions and outcomes. Every person at Sedex is encouraged to own their work, make decisions with confidence, and contribute proactively to the success of the team and the business.
· **Deliver Results**: We are results-oriented and committed to delivering tangible, impactful outcomes for our customers, our business, and society at large.

# Senior Business Development Representative
London, England, United Kingdom
We're looking for a Senior Business Development Representative to join us in a high-impact commercial role at the forefront of Voice AI. You’ll play a critical part in driving pipeline growth across enterprise and mid-market accounts, working with a genuinely differentiated API product used by technical buyers globally. You’ll operate in a fast-scaling environment, partnering closely with account executives and engaging with senior stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong sales instincts with a structured, data-driven approach and is motivated to grow within one of the most exciting and rapidly evolving areas of the tech industry.
**What you’ll be doing:**
* Building and managing pipeline across a defined territory
* Identifying and targeting enterprise and mid-market accounts
* Conducting outbound prospecting using multi-channel approaches (email, phone, LinkedIn)
* Qualifying inbound and outbound leads to create high-quality opportunities
* Partnering closely with Account Executives to progress and convert opportunities
* Tailoring messaging to both technical and commercial stakeholders
* Using tools like Salesforce, sequencing platforms, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to manage activity and performance
* Leveraging AI tools to research accounts and personalise outreach
**Who we are looking for:**
* Demonstrated success hitting or exceeding targets, with clear evidence of performance and impact
* Brings a methodical, organised approach to territory management and pipeline building
* Able to confidently engage both technical buyers (e.g. CTOs) and business leaders with tailored messaging
* Comfortable selling complex or intangible products such as APIs, platforms, or developer tools
* Ambitious, coachable, and motivated to develop into more senior commercial roles as the company scales
*We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.*
**Who we are:**
Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.
Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.
We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.
This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey...
**What we can offer you:**
No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.
We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.
**At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there.**
That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.
But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.
**So, come as you are and join our Speechling community.** We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.
For more information on us,please visit our website and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 700 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. You’ll work on marketing, commercial strategy, RevOps, reporting & analytics, and generally anything that helps accelerate our growth.
This is not an easy job – but we can promise it’ll be incredibly stimulating & fulfilling, and you’ll struggle to find a lovelier, more engaged group of customers to work with (..and the team’s not bad either!).
## 🌲 About Spruce
* Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to make reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But there’s a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.
* We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on hundreds of installation businesses, merchants, utilities and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line.
* We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you *might* get a sense of where we’re headed...
## 🥖 The Role
As we drive the business towards the next fundraise, you’ll be working closely with Hector and our founder Jo getting stuck into pretty much everything that goes on across the growth side of business. No two days will be the same, but at minimum your work will include:
* Running growth experiments – setting up and running our full set of growth/marketing tests, quickly binning things that don’t work, and iterating quickly on everything to find our growth levers.
* Creating & managing ads, creative, and content – top and middle-funnel marketing content, videos, customer testimonials, short form copy for our website, socials, ads, and nurturing emails, and onboarding guides for new customers.
* Supporting sales & customer success – building the systems that allow our commercial teams to scale hyper-efficiently and deliver exponentially more value per hour of work they do.
* Data analysis & reporting – digging into how our customers are using the platform, breaking down conversion rates through our marketing and sales pipelines, spotting areas we can improve, and coming up with suggestions for when and how we should change tack.

You’ll have somewhere between 1 and 6 years work experience (doesn’t matter if it’s not directly related to this role) and you’ll ideally be:
* Relentlessly proactive – you naturally take responsibility, are always pushing to make things better, and just want to crack on and get sh\*t done;
* A brilliant communicator — you write compelling, concise copy and can explain complex concepts simply;
* Highly analytical — you have a real affinity for numbers, love diving into data, and are comfortable working in Excel;
* A natural “people person” — you love working with people, find it easy to warm to them and quickly put them at ease;
* An AI whizz – you’re way ahead of the average person with your LLM usage, have built interesting/cool things in your spare time, and are deeply conscious of all the things that are possible that you haven’t had a chance to try yet;
... and you’ll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓

* 🍰 Slice of equity (options) in the company
* 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year
* 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

* 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

* You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
## **What sets us apart**
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.
## **Meet the team behind this journey**
Our Language AI teams form the foundation of DeepL's success. We are a dedicated group of researchers who collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers. Our mission is to build the world's leading language AI system to deliver perfect translations for the most demanding use cases. To that end, we take responsibility for the entire life cycle of the machine learning models that power our language AI products. This includes data, training, quality assurance, and operational aspects. In our highly collaborative teams, each person has the scope to drive impact across the company.
## **Your responsibilities**
We are looking for a Senior Research Scientist to own the foundational modelling decisions behind the next generation of our most capable translation models. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for a researcher who can prototype rapidly, run large-scale experiments, and drive modelling choices all the way into production.
In this competitive and highly dynamic field, you will decide which foundation models we build on, which architectures we adopt as we scale, and how we adapt a strong base model into a highly capable translation system working side by side with our post-training, RL, and instruction-following experts.
### You will:
* Drive the selection and evaluation of open foundation / open-weight models as the basis for our next-generation translation systems.
* Lead model selection and general architecture decisions for scaling to hundreds of billions of parameters, including Mixture-of-Experts and other sparse or efficient designs.
* Design multi-capability adaptation strategies using LoRA, PEFT, and related methods.
* Own the modelling lifecycle for your work: prototyping, ablations, scaling experiments, evaluation, and delivery into production, with rigorous and reproducible evaluation.
* Partner closely with post-training, RL/RLHF, and instruction-following specialists to integrate alignment and capability work into the base model.
* Stay ahead of the open-model and scaling literature, and bring well-founded recommendations back to the team.
## **Qualities we look for**
* Strong hands-on experience adapting and scaling large language models via fine-tuning, instruction-tuning, or post-training of multi-billion-parameter models beyond black-box use.
* Sound judgment about architecture trade-offs at scale (e.g. dense vs. MoE) and about which open-weight foundation models to build on.
* Working knowledge of parameter-efficient and multi-capability adaptation (LoRA/PEFT and variants).
* A hands-on builder who enjoys training models, running experiments, and debugging pipelines, and who can carry research results through to production with engineering.
* Strong coding and experimentation skills (Python, PyTorch/JAX/Tensorflow).
* Ability to communicate clearly, collaborate across teams, and align research work with product and engineering priorities.
## Nice to have
* Experience quantifying uncertainty in large models — calibration and confidence estimation via Bayesian methods, ensembling, steering, or prompt-based approaches.
* Experience with machine translation, multilingual NLP, or document-/layout-aware modelling experience.
* Familiarity with MoE-specific training and adaptation (e.g. expert routing, Mixture-of-LoRA-Experts) and large-scale data-mixture design.
## **What we offer**
* **Diverse and internationally distributed team**: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
* **Open communication, regular feedback**: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
* **Hybrid work, flexible hours**: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. # Financial Planning & Analysis Manager
**Advert Close date: 13th August 2026**
## Purpose of Role
As Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager, you will play a key role in strengthening The Crown Estate’s financial planning, reporting and performance management activities. Supporting the Senior FP&A Manager, you will help deliver high-quality budgets, forecasts and long-term plans that enable informed decision-making and support the organisation’s strategic objectives.
Acting as a central point of coordination across finance teams, you will translate complex financial information into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders and Board stakeholders. You will also drive continuous improvement in planning processes and support effective capital allocation through robust financial analysis and modelling.
## Context of Opportunity / Main Accountabilities
This is an exciting opportunity to join a purpose-led organisation where financial insight directly supports long-term value creation for the UK.
Key responsibilities include:
* Owning and acting as the super user of the FP&A Anaplan model, ensuring data integrity and effective use across planning and reporting cycles.
* Coordinating the consolidation of monthly forecasts, annual budgets and long-term plans, providing clear visibility of key assumptions and performance drivers.
* Producing high-quality financial reporting and performance packs for senior leadership and Board audiences.
* Delivering detailed variance analysis, identifying trends, risks, opportunities and performance drivers across the business.
* Providing forward-looking insight through scenario planning, forecasting and risk assessment.
* Building strong partnerships with Commercial SBU and Group Partners Finance teams, constructively challenging assumptions and improving forecast quality.
* Supporting capital allocation decisions by connecting financial plans with value creation, return on investment and strategic priorities.
* Driving enhancements to planning, reporting and performance management processes.
## Most Important Skills Based Requirements
* Professional finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) or relevant experience.
* Strong experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning within a complex organisation.
* Strong understanding of FP&A best practice, performance management and financial reporting.
* Proven ability to analyse financial data, identify key drivers and communicate insights effectively to senior stakeholders.
* Experience working with planning systems; Anaplan experience is highly desirable.
* Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with experience managing large datasets.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence influencing and constructively challenging colleagues at all levels.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information into clear business insight.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented and committed to continuous improvement.

The Family Drug and Alcohol Court (FDAC) is a national therapeutic, problem-solving court model, which offers an alternative route to standard care proceedings. Your role will require you to provide expertise, assessment, support and intervention to parents, where domestic abuse and relationship issues are prevalent and who require the specialist interventions of a Domestic Abuse worker.
You will work closely with a range of other professionals, both within the team and externally. Your role will require you to contribute to regular court reports and also to attend court on occasions to support your allocated families through the FDAC proceedings.

The specialist multi-disciplinary FDAC team includes therapeutic social workers, clinical psychologists, substance misuse, domestic abuse and parenting workers to provide intensive support, built around the family, designed to enable and empower parents to overcome their difficulties.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with all team members, including the FDAC Clinical Psychologist, to develop your own specialist knowledge and resources to effect change.

## About the project
Trees for Cities is delighted to support the Mayor of London, Sadiq Khan's new London Tree Equity and Urban Resilience (TE&UR) project a grant-funded partnership scheme initiated by the Greater London Authority (GLA) to improve access to trees, and the benefits they provide, within London neighbourhoods facing high heat risk and wider social vulnerability. We'll be engaging Londoners in target boroughs to help plant and care for more trees where they're needed most.
As part of our role in this project, we are inviting bids from suitably qualified consultants to support delivery of the Tree Equity and Urban Resilience (TE&UR) initiative.

However, the process diagram on page 12 of the brief appears to show the investment planning element delivered by the consultant continuing into 2028 and running concurrently with the 27-28 planting season. Please confirm if we should therefore assume a March 2028 end date.

## Inclusion is in our roots
We are proud to have consistently put disadvantaged communities first since we established 30 years ago, working closely with them to achieve fairer access to the benefits that flow from trees in urban places.
Working at the intersection between social and environmental justice, with a people-centred theory of change, we differ from many organisations who operate entirely in one space or the other. Equity, diversity and inclusion are prominent in our 2022-2025 strategy 'The Turn of Trees' and have also been featured before. However, we share common challenges with the environment sector in that our workforce is typically less diverse than the communities we work with.
We are confident in our inclusive culture, evidenced through staff surveys, and our inclusive public tree-related events. We go the extra mile to ensure a broad range of people feel welcome, especially those with the most to gain from greening their area and learning about how to care for trees.
We are actively taking steps to deepen how and where we work with a view to increasing equity, diversity and inclusion. This statement sets out how we plan to go further, as well as clarifying the vision and priorities for doing so.
We know that environmental justice is inextricably linked to social justice around the world. We try to fold this understanding into who we work with and how, and by bringing people and nature closer together where this is needed the most.
We are a recognised champion for equity, diversity and inclusion, progressively implementing a values-based approach in what we do, how we do it, and who we do it with. In doing so, we better reflect the communities we work with through our team and volunteers and listen deeply to their views. Our partners, funders and supporters are clear on our values and ways of working relating to equity, diversity and inclusion. They champion our values with us, and we have conversations when needed to challenge and enhance them.
We are increasingly collaborating with diverse people, fostering healthy conversations, and opening up platforms where we are naturally trusted to do the right thing. We are learning and sharing our insights, and championing where others embrace a similar ethos. We are continuously enhancing our decision-making processes, including where we are targeting our efforts, to create more equity for people in relation to trees in urban places.

## Build Cyber Training Rooms for 8M+ Learners
**Build the world's best cyber training rooms. Get paid. Get credited.**
TryHackMe is looking for security practitioners to build hands-on rooms trained on by 8 million+ learners across companies, universities and military teams worldwide. You bring the expertise. This is a paid, fully remote, fully async contract opportunity. You work on your own schedule, to a clear brief, over a two to four week window per room.
**What you'll build**
A room is a self-contained, hands-on lab. Learners read your tasks, attack or defend a live environment you design, and submit flags to prove they did it for real. You write the whole experience: the tasks, the flags, the hints, the walkthrough and the scenario behind the lab we host for you. No infrastructure to run yourself, just your knowledge turned into something people learn from.
**Where we're building**
We build across ten streams, from beginner foundations to senior, enterprise-grade depth: Foundations, Red Team, Blue Team, AI Security, Cloud, Product Security, OT/ICS, Security Engineering, GRC and Leadership. Tell us your strongest area when you apply and we will match you to what is live. If you have a strong idea that fits our roadmap, you can pitch your own.
**What you get**
* A fixed fee per room, agreed in writing before you start. Fees typically run $500 to $2,000 USD, scaled to complexity. No hourly tracking and no surprises.
* Permanent credit: your handle and avatar stay on every room you build.
* A public, portfolio-ready creator profile of your rooms, completions and ratings.
* First pick on new topics in your area as you build a track record with us.

* Security practitioners, CTF authors, pentesters, researchers and educators.
* People who know their topic inside out and can teach it clearly.
* Builders who have played or made CTF challenges and understand what makes them click.
* No degree or specific certification required. We look at your work, not your CV.
